# Summary

Join our digital marketing agency as an Ads & SEO Manager to oversee paid advertising campaigns and organic search performance for multiple clients. This role requires full ownership of campaigns and SEO strategy, managing them independently while collaborating with our marketing team to achieve measurable ROI and search visibility gains. The position is remote with flexible hours and potential for full-time growth.

## Deliverables

### Campaign Management

- Plan, launch, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and other relevant platforms
- Take full ownership of campaign performance and results from strategy through execution
- Manage multiple client ad accounts simultaneously with varying budgets and objectives
- Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitive analysis
- Design and execute comprehensive A/B testing strategies for ad copy, creatives, landing pages, and audiences to continuously improve performance
- Implement unit testing methodologies to validate campaign components before launch
- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimizations
- Manage ad budgets efficiently to maximize ROI for clients

### SEO & SERP Management

- Own on-page, technical, and off-page SEO strategy for multiple client websites
- Conduct keyword research and mapping to identify high-value organic opportunities, aligning with paid search targeting where relevant
- Monitor SERP rankings, visibility, and share-of-voice across target keywords, and track fluctuations tied to algorithm updates
- Perform technical SEO audits (site speed, crawlability, indexation, schema markup, mobile usability, Core Web Vitals) and coordinate fixes with dev/design teams
- Optimize on-page elements (title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, content structure) to improve rankings and CTR
- Analyze competitor SERP positioning and identify content gaps and link-building opportunities
- Develop and guide content briefs that support target keyword rankings, coordinating with content and design teams
- Track local SEO performance (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews) for local service clients
- Monitor and report on organic traffic, rankings, impressions, and CTR trends alongside paid metrics for a unified acquisition view
- Stay current on Google algorithm updates, search engine guidelines, and evolving SERP features (featured snippets, AI Overviews, local packs, etc.)

### Media Creation & Strategy

- Assist with media creation including ad copy writing, creative briefs, and basic graphic design coordination
- Proactively research and recommend new media opportunities and platforms to expand client reach
- Lead discussions with clients and team about emerging advertising and search channels and innovative campaign approaches
- Develop advertising and SEO strategies aligned with client business goals
- Stay current on platform updates, best practices, and industry trends
- Identify opportunities for campaign expansion and improvement across both paid and organic channels
- Recommend budget adjustments based on performance data
- Collaborate with content and design teams on ad creative and SEO content needs

### Reporting & Communication

- Create clear, actionable monthly performance reports for clients covering both paid and organic search performance
- Provide strategic recommendations based on campaign and SEO data and market insights
- Communicate campaign and SERP performance, insights, and recommendations to account managers
- Participate in client calls when needed to discuss strategy and results
- Track and report on key metrics: CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, organic rankings, organic traffic, and keyword visibility
- Available during 9am-5pm Central Time at least 4-6 hours presence for team collaboration

## Required Qualifications

- 5+ years managing paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads required)
- 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical, on-page, and content-driven SEO
- Proven track record of managing $10K+ monthly ad budgets
- Demonstrated experience improving organic search rankings and visibility for multiple websites
- Demonstrated experience with A/B testing methodologies and statistical significance analysis
- Experience assisting with or directing media creation for digital campaigns
- Experience working in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts
- Google Ads certification (required)
- Meta Blueprint certification (preferred)
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console
- Proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or similar for keyword research, rank tracking, and audits
- Ability to take full ownership of accounts with minimal supervision
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Self-motivated and able to work independently
- Experience with reporting tools (Google Data Studio, Looker Studio, or similar)

## Nice-to-Have Skills

- LinkedIn Ads experience
- Microsoft Ads (Bing) experience
- Experience with landing page optimization and CRO
- Experience with unit testing frameworks for digital marketing campaigns
- Basic design skills (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite basics)
- Familiarity with CRM systems (particularly lead tracking and attribution)
- E-commerce advertising and SEO experience (Shopify, WooCommerce)
- Local service business advertising and local SEO experience
- Experience with link-building outreach and digital PR
- Familiarity with structured data / schema markup implementation
- Experience with JIRA or project management tools

## What We're Looking For

Someone who can hit the ground running, take full ownership of client advertising campaigns and SEO strategy, and free up our team to focus on strategic growth initiatives. You should be comfortable working independently across both paid and organic search channels while keeping stakeholders informed of progress and results. We need someone who thinks like an owner - proactively identifying opportunities across paid and organic search, recommending new approaches, and driving results without constant oversight.

# Summary

Join our digital marketing agency as an Ads & SEO Manager to oversee paid advertising campaigns and organic search performance for multiple clients. This role requires full ownership of campaigns and SEO strategy, managing them independently while collaborating with our marketing team to achieve measurable ROI and search visibility gains. The position is remote with flexible hours and potential for full-time growth.

## Deliverables

### Campaign Management

- Plan, launch, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and other relevant platforms
- Take full ownership of campaign performance and results from strategy through execution
- Manage multiple client ad accounts simultaneously with varying budgets and objectives
- Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitive analysis
- Design and execute comprehensive A/B testing strategies for ad copy, creatives, landing pages, and audiences to continuously improve performance
- Implement unit testing methodologies to validate campaign components before launch
- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimizations
- Manage ad budgets efficiently to maximize ROI for clients

### SEO & SERP Management

- Own on-page, technical, and off-page SEO strategy for multiple client websites
- Conduct keyword research and mapping to identify high-value organic opportunities, aligning with paid search targeting where relevant
- Monitor SERP rankings, visibility, and share-of-voice across target keywords, and track fluctuations tied to algorithm updates
- Perform technical SEO audits (site speed, crawlability, indexation, schema markup, mobile usability, Core Web Vitals) and coordinate fixes with dev/design teams
- Optimize on-page elements (title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, content structure) to improve rankings and CTR
- Analyze competitor SERP positioning and identify content gaps and link-building opportunities
- Develop and guide content briefs that support target keyword rankings, coordinating with content and design teams
- Track local SEO performance (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews) for local service clients
- Monitor and report on organic traffic, rankings, impressions, and CTR trends alongside paid metrics for a unified acquisition view
- Stay current on Google algorithm updates, search engine guidelines, and evolving SERP features (featured snippets, AI Overviews, local packs, etc.)

### Media Creation & Strategy

- Assist with media creation including ad copy writing, creative briefs, and basic graphic design coordination
- Proactively research and recommend new media opportunities and platforms to expand client reach
- Lead discussions with clients and team about emerging advertising and search channels and innovative campaign approaches
- Develop advertising and SEO strategies aligned with client business goals
- Stay current on platform updates, best practices, and industry trends
- Identify opportunities for campaign expansion and improvement across both paid and organic channels
- Recommend budget adjustments based on performance data
- Collaborate with content and design teams on ad creative and SEO content needs

### Reporting & Communication

- Create clear, actionable monthly performance reports for clients covering both paid and organic search performance
- Provide strategic recommendations based on campaign and SEO data and market insights
- Communicate campaign and SERP performance, insights, and recommendations to account managers
- Participate in client calls when needed to discuss strategy and results
- Track and report on key metrics: CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, organic rankings, organic traffic, and keyword visibility
- Available during 9am-5pm Central Time at least 4-6 hours presence for team collaboration

## Required Qualifications

- 5+ years managing paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads required)
- 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical, on-page, and content-driven SEO
- Proven track record of managing $10K+ monthly ad budgets
- Demonstrated experience improving organic search rankings and visibility for multiple websites
- Demonstrated experience with A/B testing methodologies and statistical significance analysis
- Experience assisting with or directing media creation for digital campaigns
- Experience working in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts
- Google Ads certification (required)
- Meta Blueprint certification (preferred)
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console
- Proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or similar for keyword research, rank tracking, and audits
- Ability to take full ownership of accounts with minimal supervision
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Self-motivated and able to work independently
- Experience with reporting tools (Google Data Studio, Looker Studio, or similar)

## Nice-to-Have Skills

- LinkedIn Ads experience
- Microsoft Ads (Bing) experience
- Experience with landing page optimization and CRO
- Experience with unit testing frameworks for digital marketing campaigns
- Basic design skills (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite basics)
- Familiarity with CRM systems (particularly lead tracking and attribution)
- E-commerce advertising and SEO experience (Shopify, WooCommerce)
- Local service business advertising and local SEO experience
- Experience with link-building outreach and digital PR
- Familiarity with structured data / schema markup implementation
- Experience with JIRA or project management tools

## What We're Looking For

Someone who can hit the ground running, take full ownership of client advertising campaigns and SEO strategy, and free up our team to focus on strategic growth initiatives. You should be comfortable working independently across both paid and organic search channels while keeping stakeholders informed of progress and results. We need someone who thinks like an owner - proactively identifying opportunities across paid and organic search, recommending new approaches, and driving results without constant oversight.

# Summary

Join our digital marketing agency as an Ads & SEO Manager to oversee paid advertising campaigns and organic search performance for multiple clients. This role requires full ownership of campaigns and SEO strategy, managing them independently while collaborating with our marketing team to achieve measurable ROI and search visibility gains. The position is remote with flexible hours and potential for full-time growth.

## Deliverables

### Campaign Management

- Plan, launch, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and other relevant platforms
- Take full ownership of campaign performance and results from strategy through execution
- Manage multiple client ad accounts simultaneously with varying budgets and objectives
- Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, and competitive analysis
- Design and execute comprehensive A/B testing strategies for ad copy, creatives, landing pages, and audiences to continuously improve performance
- Implement unit testing methodologies to validate campaign components before launch
- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimizations
- Manage ad budgets efficiently to maximize ROI for clients

### SEO & SERP Management

- Own on-page, technical, and off-page SEO strategy for multiple client websites
- Conduct keyword research and mapping to identify high-value organic opportunities, aligning with paid search targeting where relevant
- Monitor SERP rankings, visibility, and share-of-voice across target keywords, and track fluctuations tied to algorithm updates
- Perform technical SEO audits (site speed, crawlability, indexation, schema markup, mobile usability, Core Web Vitals) and coordinate fixes with dev/design teams
- Optimize on-page elements (title tags, meta descriptions, headers, internal linking, content structure) to improve rankings and CTR
- Analyze competitor SERP positioning and identify content gaps and link-building opportunities
- Develop and guide content briefs that support target keyword rankings, coordinating with content and design teams
- Track local SEO performance (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews) for local service clients
- Monitor and report on organic traffic, rankings, impressions, and CTR trends alongside paid metrics for a unified acquisition view
- Stay current on Google algorithm updates, search engine guidelines, and evolving SERP features (featured snippets, AI Overviews, local packs, etc.)

### Media Creation & Strategy

- Assist with media creation including ad copy writing, creative briefs, and basic graphic design coordination
- Proactively research and recommend new media opportunities and platforms to expand client reach
- Lead discussions with clients and team about emerging advertising and search channels and innovative campaign approaches
- Develop advertising and SEO strategies aligned with client business goals
- Stay current on platform updates, best practices, and industry trends
- Identify opportunities for campaign expansion and improvement across both paid and organic channels
- Recommend budget adjustments based on performance data
- Collaborate with content and design teams on ad creative and SEO content needs

### Reporting & Communication

- Create clear, actionable monthly performance reports for clients covering both paid and organic search performance
- Provide strategic recommendations based on campaign and SEO data and market insights
- Communicate campaign and SERP performance, insights, and recommendations to account managers
- Participate in client calls when needed to discuss strategy and results
- Track and report on key metrics: CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rates, organic rankings, organic traffic, and keyword visibility
- Available during 9am-5pm Central Time at least 4-6 hours presence for team collaboration

## Required Qualifications

- 5+ years managing paid advertising campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads required)
- 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, including technical, on-page, and content-driven SEO
- Proven track record of managing $10K+ monthly ad budgets
- Demonstrated experience improving organic search rankings and visibility for multiple websites
- Demonstrated experience with A/B testing methodologies and statistical significance analysis
- Experience assisting with or directing media creation for digital campaigns
- Experience working in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts
- Google Ads certification (required)
- Meta Blueprint certification (preferred)
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console
- Proficiency with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or similar for keyword research, rank tracking, and audits
- Ability to take full ownership of accounts with minimal supervision
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Self-motivated and able to work independently
- Experience with reporting tools (Google Data Studio, Looker Studio, or similar)

## Nice-to-Have Skills

- LinkedIn Ads experience
- Microsoft Ads (Bing) experience
- Experience with landing page optimization and CRO
- Experience with unit testing frameworks for digital marketing campaigns
- Basic design skills (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite basics)
- Familiarity with CRM systems (particularly lead tracking and attribution)
- E-commerce advertising and SEO experience (Shopify, WooCommerce)
- Local service business advertising and local SEO experience
- Experience with link-building outreach and digital PR
- Familiarity with structured data / schema markup implementation
- Experience with JIRA or project management tools

## What We're Looking For

Someone who can hit the ground running, take full ownership of client advertising campaigns and SEO strategy, and free up our team to focus on strategic growth initiatives. You should be comfortable working independently across both paid and organic search channels while keeping stakeholders informed of progress and results. We need someone who thinks like an owner - proactively identifying opportunities across paid and organic search, recommending new approaches, and driving results without constant oversight.

record.FireCrawl Job Description:
Precision AQ is seeking a strategic marketer to drive the integrated marketing strategy, connecting thought leadership, digital activation, demand generation, campaigns, events, account priorities, and sales enablement into a cohesive approach that supports measurable business impact. 

The ideal candidate is a builder, modernizer, and team player who brings a strong commercial mindset, leveraging data, emerging technologies, and AI to enhance marketing effectiveness, improve operational efficiency, and create scalable processes that position Marketing as a strategic growth driver across the organization. 

Main Duties & Responsibilities 

- Lead integrated campaigns aligned with growth priorities, target audiences, and priority accounts; develop briefs, messaging, journeys, channel plans, and activation calendars

- Work with the marketing and practice teams to align the thought leadership strategy and editorial plan. Partner with subject matter experts to develop differentiated perspectives in the span the customer segments and solutions we bring to our customer segments

- Turn expert insight into articles, reports, white papers, webinars, newsletters, executive content, and reusable campaign assets

- Direct digital strategies across the website, email, social media, search, paid media, and marketing automation to increase reach, engagement, and qualified demand

- Connect conference and event marketing to campaigns before, during, and after key industry moments.

- Partner with commercial leaders and the sales team on account-based programs, targeting and segmentation of ICPs, and client engagement strategies.

- Maintain clear, consistent brand storytelling and editorial quality across channels.

- Partner with practice area leaders and subject matter experts to identify, prioritize, and execute paid and earned media strategies that increase brand visibility, promote thought leadership, and drive audience engagement.

- Design and lead segmentation and targeting of priority clients and buying centers, partnering with commercial teams to deliver personalized campaigns and account-specific content that increase penetration, opportunity creation, and client growth.

- Utilize AI tools to orchestrate new workflows in processes, data outputs and scheduling 

- Track and manage KPIs and use HubSpot, Salesforce, and campaign data to report engagement, MQLs, opportunity influence, and funnel progression; optimize based on results.

record.Gecko Job Description:
AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey. 

We're looking for a B2B Growth Marketing Manager – Industrial/SaaS  who wakes up thinking about pipeline. In this role, you'll own the strategy and hands-on execution of full-funnel, multi-channel campaigns that drive real revenue; building in HubSpot, pulling the levers, and iterating relentlessly until the numbers move. This is a fast-scaling SaaS environment where every campaign decision is made through one lens: what gets more qualified opportunities into the funnel, faster.

This isn't your typical enterprise SaaS role. AssetWatch sells into the manufacturing plant floor - maintenance managers, reliability engineers, plant managers, and operations leaders who aren't scrolling LinkedIn between meetings. Reaching them requires a dual playbook: account-based tactics for executive buyers, and channel-agnostic creative for the plant-level practitioners who champion the technology.

This role blends campaign strategy, cross-functional leadership, and technical campaign execution, and it demands someone who plans obsessively and operates with precision. You'll be managing multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously, and the throughline that keeps it all moving is your ability to build the system, run the system, and hold it accountable to pipeline.

What You’ll Do:

Campaign Strategy & Execution 

- Develop and execute integrated, multi-channel campaigns to drive demand, pipeline, and revenue 

- Translate business goals into coordinated campaigns across email, paid media, web, events, and sales outreach 

- Own campaign execution end-to-end, including building and launching campaigns in HubSpot 

Marketing Automation & Campaign Operations 

- Build, test, and deploy campaign assets in HubSpot (emails, landing pages, workflows, forms) 

- Partner with Lifecycle Marketing to ensure proper segmentation, targeting, and timing 

- Manage campaign workflows and triggers to support lead generation and nurture efforts 

- Ensure campaigns are properly tracked, tagged, and attributed 

Cross-Functional Alignment 

- Collaborate with product marketing, content, design, and sales to align messaging and campaign goals 

- Work closely with RevOps to ensure Salesforce and HubSpot alignment for campaign tracking and lead flow 

- Support sales with campaign insights, follow-up strategies, and enablement materials

Performance & Optimization 

- Define KPIs (MQLs, pipeline, conversion rates, campaign ROI) 

- Monitor campaign performance and optimize in real time (A/B testing, messaging, timing, channels) 

- Build and maintain campaign reporting dashboards in HubSpot 

Data & Compliance 

- Ensure campaigns follow best practices for data usage, segmentation, and compliance (CAN-SPAM, GDPR) 

- Maintain clean campaign data and proper attribution tracking 

Qualifications

- 4–7+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, demand generation, or integrated campaigns 

- Hands-on experience executing campaigns in HubSpot (or similar MAP) 

- Strong understanding of pipeline generation and SaaS funnel metrics 

- Experience working with Salesforce CRMand marketing-sales alignment 

- Ability to manage both strategy and execution in a fast-paced environment 

What Success Looks Like

- Campaigns consistently generate qualified pipeline and revenue 

- Seamless execution from strategy → build → launch → optimization 

- Strong alignment between marketing campaigns and sales outcomes 

- Clear, reliable campaign reporting and attribution

#LI-REMOTE

AssetWatch is a remote-first company that puts people at the center of everything we do. We want our team members to thrive - that’s why we offer a range of benefits and perks designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

- Competitive compensation package including stock options

- Flexible work schedule

- Comprehensive benefits including retirement plan match

- Opportunity to make a real impact every day

- Work with a dynamic and growing team

- Unlimited PTO

We have a distributed team that works remotely across locations in the United States and Ontario, Canada. Collaboration within core working hours is required.

record.Gecko Job Description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

 

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, tech-forward product marketer to grow our Observability products by boldly positioning them and running campaigns to attract, convert and retain customers. As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be in charge of the messaging and positioning for a broad product area. Then you’ll work closely with product managers and the marketing team to deliver campaigns, content, events, and training that help buyers buy (and sellers sell) our value.

Product Marketing lives within the Product org rather than the Marketing org at Grafana Labs, and we think differently about the job. Rather than purely executing launches or campaigns, we want PMMs to teach product managers and engineers in our org how to think about growth and demand, and to codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone in the organization can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

Grafana Labs is a fast-paced and growing organization. As such, this role requires strategic skills, an interest in teaching, and hands-on tactical execution (blogs, webinar outlines, video scripts, etc). Our team is full of people who crave impact and independence - if you are seeking a role with narrow scope where you run a defined playbook, this is not the job for you.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Actively partner with and teach product managers to define product value, messaging, and go-to-market strategy, from competitive positioning to sales enablement collateral.
  • Partner with product management, engineering and various go-to-market functions to create materials that help customers evaluate and adopt our products: reference architectures, implementation guides, detailed product information and more.
  • Own customer lifecycle campaigns (competitive positioning, retention, upsell/cross-sell) to strategically shape marketing programs and drive growth across the entire customer journey.
  • Conduct market and customer research to understand pain points, competition and opportunities.
  • Teach go-to-market and sales teams our products’ capabilities and the value they provide, deliver training and enablement, ensure customer facing teams are able to effectively engage with customers, partners, and prospects.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 4+ years of relevant experience (product marketing, solutions marketing, product management)
  • Experience with marketing and selling to a technical audience
  • A passion for open source, cloud native, and infrastructure technologies 
  • Proven ability to take on complex projects and efficiently drive them from start to finish
  • Ability to clearly articulate the value of technical products to customers and sellers alike
  • Experience leading product or feature launches autonomously as well as part of a team
  • Experience working with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate messaging and workflows
  • Comfort working with a variety of internal and external stakeholders in complicated processes
  • Strong product and technical curiosity that translate to clear packaging, positioning, and messaging
  • Demonstrated quantitative analytical skills for analyzing campaign performance, evaluating lifecycle metrics, and making data-driven recommendations.
  • Exceptional writing and communication skills
  • A high “say-do” ratio in executing and delivering impact 

Compensation & Rewards:

In Spain, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 82,988 - EUR 99,586. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

record.Gecko Job Description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Role context

This role sits on the Product Marketing team and reports to the Director of Product Marketing. You'll be aligned to one or more of our product pillars and work with one to three product managers and their engineers, taking products from alpha through public beta to general availability. You're the translator between what product and engineering build and the language sales and customers use.

The role

You will own how your products reach the market, from first alpha to GA.

- 

Plan and run launches for mid-tier (P2) products end to end, and lead a major workstream on our biggest (P1) launches, so sales and customer teams are ready on launch day.

- 

Shape messaging, positioning and naming with your product counterpart so technical capabilities land as clear value for both the buyer and the frontline technician.

- 

Build the collateral, video scripts and enablement that help reps close faster and help customers adopt what we ship.

- 

Partner with Demand Gen on campaign messaging and review what goes to market.

- 

Use analytics tools, customer conversations and market research to understand buyers, and own an adoption goal, shared with your product counterpart, that we review every week.

Within six to twelve months, product, sales and marketing should see you as the person to ask about your products. You'll have real autonomy to set strategy with your product counterpart and bring recommendations to your manager. Your priorities will shift each quarter with what the business needs.

About you

Must-haves

- 

2–4 years in product marketing or a closely related role, such as sales enablement, sales or marketing

- 

You've taken a product launch from plan to release and can tell us what worked and what didn't

- 

You write clearly and present with confidence to sales, product and executive audiences

- 

You've worked with go-to-market teams before and after the sale

- 

You're comfortable getting hands-on in tools like Tableau, Databricks and Salesforce to check on customers and adoption

- 

You see the whole picture: tell you one thing and you can map the many moving parts behind it

- 

You welcome feedback, take accountability, and know when to push and when to agree and move on

Nice-to-haves

- 

Background in manufacturing, industrial or other asset-intensive industries

- 

Experience marketing B2B software or AI products

We offer

Your work shows up in the physical world. What we ship keeps factories, fleets and campuses running, and when it works, a technician goes home on time. You're joining a product the industry already loves, now part of Autodesk, with the scale of a global public company pointed at the problem we were already solving. The seat is early, not inherited: the team is small enough that you can name the parts of the launch process you own. And operations is new ground inside Autodesk, so the people who join now have real room to grow.

Values and how we work

We reward output and promote quickly when people deliver. Product marketing here means navigating strong opinions from product, sales and marketing, because everyone cares about the work. We look for people who are smart, humble and optimistic: open to feedback, easy to work with, and honest about what didn't go to plan.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build. 

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it. 

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

record.Gecko Job Description:
We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team. This role owns the go-to-market (GTM) strategy for one or more products within the Articulate platform, including the GTM plan against revenue goals and the commercial model behind it.
You will shape messaging, pricing and packaging, use funnel data and AI systems to sharpen the plan, and build the launch foundations for execution. You will partner with product, marketing, sales, customer success, growth, ops, and ecosystem and reseller partners to shape the roadmap and carry recommendations to senior leaders. We are looking for someone who writes the playbook, builds the systems the team runs on, and is accountable for the plan that delivers a revenue goal.

- Revenue and GTM plan. Own the GTM plan against the revenue goal for your product(s). Work with Sales and Ops on targets, track progress against them, and decide what to scale, fix, pause or stop as results come in.

- 

Commercial model. Shape the pricing, packaging, and monetization approach for your product(s). Make recommendations and carry them through to a decision with cross-functional partners.

- 

Shared context and systems. Build and maintain the positioning, messaging, and competitive context, plus the skills and workflows, that the PMM team and its AI agents run on.

- 

Funnel data and insights. Own the funnel for your product(s), from first touch through conversion and expansion. Help shape the dashboards and metrics the team relies on, using them to turn insights into GTM strategy and execution.

- 

Field readiness. Act as the voice of product, owning field messaging, FAQs, web content, and live enablement for Sales, Customer Success, and reseller partners.

- 

Build positioning, value propositions, and differentiated messaging for the full buying committee, from practitioners and business creators to administrators and IT stakeholders, and hold a high quality bar on what the team ships

- 

Develop deep insight into customers, segments, and target accounts, and use research, usage data, and buying signals to guide GTM plans and the roadmap

- 

Build the launch and campaign foundations (plans, templates, assets, standards) that Growth, Content, and Sales execute from

- 

Work with Product and Engineering on the roadmap, and make the case for what to build next and how it should be priced and packaged

- 

Work with Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Marketing leadership to reach decisions on commercial strategy that cross teams

- 

Adapt GTM across ecosystem, integration, and reseller partners as revenue channels, including positioning, co-marketing, enablement, and shared account plans

- 

Build with AI every day - create workflows and agents for your own work, and add to the team's shared context, skills, and agents so everyone's output improves

- 

Decide what to do yourself, what to delegate, and what to automate

- 

Create internal and field assets, track competitors and market trends, and support events

- 

8+ years of product marketing experience, B2B SaaS preferred

- 

A track record of owning a GTM plan against a revenue goal or other commercial outcome, and making calls on what to scale, fix, or stop based on data

- 

Experience shaping pricing, packaging, and monetization, ideally including usage-based or credit-based models

- 

Hands-on AI proficiency to speed up your work and apply your own judgment to the output

- 

A high-quality bar for excellent storytelling with the ability to turn complex or technical ideas into a clear narrative that stands out

- 

Experience owning a funnel, plus strong comfort with funnel metrics and dashboards used to shape messaging, strategy, and decisions

- 

Experience building a launch or GTM framework from a blank page that others then adopted

- 

Ability to operate in ambiguity, flex across shifting priorities, and execute in adjacent areas like Growth, Ops and even Sales

- 

Experience with ecosystem, integration, or reseller partnerships, ideally as a revenue channel

- 

Proven ability to make strategic recommendations to senior leaders and reach a decision

- 

Strong cross-functional collaboration across product, sales, customer success, growth, operations, legal, and partners

- 

Experience raising the bar for peers through templates, standards, or coaching

- 

Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience, MBA preferred

- 

Nice to have: experience with e-learning creation or delivery tools, including Articulate 360

 About us

Articulate Global, LLC, is the leading SaaS provider of creator platforms for online workplace training. Founded by Adam Schwartz in 2002, Articulate provides creator tools and services that make it simple for enterprises and SMBs to develop, deliver, and analyze online workplace training that’s engaging and effective.  Increasingly, organizations must reskill employees for ever-changing remote and hybrid work environments, create learning cultures that attract and retain employees in a tight labor market, and use training to build more equitable, empowering, and engaging workplaces. Articulate helps organizations address these critical business needs with its creator platform for workplace training. Articulate 360—a suite of creator tools for online courses—was named the 7th most-loved product in the world by TrustRadius in 2021. And Rise—an all-in-one online training system that makes online training easy to create, enjoyable to take, and simple to manage—is the first creator platform for SMBs and departments within the enterprise. Articulate has more than 118,000 customers in 170 countries and counts all 100 of the Fortune 100 companies as customers.

Named one of Inc. Magazine’s Best Workplaces 2022 and a leader in building a human-centered organization, Articulate is guided by a commitment to provide the best value to customers, do right by employees, and create an equitable, empowering workplace for all. As a human-centered organization, we honor people’s humanity knowing that each person’s unique history, vulnerabilities, and social location inform how we show up with one another. We embrace our connectedness, aware that what we do and say impacts others. We give each other grace because we are all works in progress, learning and evolving every day. And we take responsibility for ourselves and are serious about our accountability to each other.  In all we do, we strive to create an equitable, sustainable, and empowering workplace while we drive results for the business and make a positive impact in the world. Read more about our values here. 

Articulate Global, LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All employment decisions at Articulate are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications directly related to the job, without regard to any protected characteristic or class, including, but not limited to, race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. Qualified candidates with criminal histories will be considered for this role in a manner consistent with applicable law. Articulate is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation related to the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at hr@articulate.com.

record.Gecko Job Description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

- Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

- Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

- Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

- Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

- Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.

- Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.

- Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.

- Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.

- Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.

- Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

- You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.

- You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.

- You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.

- You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.

- You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.

- You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.

- Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

- "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.

- You want to be told what to do this week.

- You need a ticketing system to know what matters.

- You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Location: Remote (USA, Canada or South Africa)
Department: Marketing
Role Type: Full Time / Independent Contractor if outside of the USA

About the Role
Blacksmith Agency is scaling its Marketing division to support a growing portfolio of PPC and SEO clients across multifamily, B2B and technical verticals. We are looking for an Account Strategist who can run the strategies and the PPC campaigns underneath it. This is not a role for a strategist who hands off execution and hopes it lands right. You will build the media plan, set up the tracking and be the one auditing the account when performance moves.

You will join sales calls to shape strategy, manage Google Ads, Meta and Microsoft campaigns directly, oversee PPC contractors where necessary, and ensure every client engagement delivers measurable outcomes. This is a senior, hybrid role that blends strategic ownership with hands-on paid media execution.

Key Responsibilities

Client Strategy and Leadership

- 

Lead strategy for all PPC clients across multiple industries.

- 

Join sales calls with AEs to validate scope, pitch technical recommendations and help close deals.

- 

Build 90 day, 6 month and annual growth roadmaps for clients.

- 

Translate complex marketing recommendations into simple, clear explanations for executives.

Hands-On PPC Execution

- 

Plan, launch and manage paid search campaigns in Google Ads across multiple client accounts, including search, display, remarketing and Performance Max structures.

- 

Conduct keyword research, audience targeting and write and edit ad copy.

- 

Set up conversion tracking and ensure attribution accuracy via GA4, GTM and CRM integrations.

- 

Monitor daily spend and pacing to keep campaigns within budget while hitting CPA and CPL goals.

- 

Identify and manage negative keywords to improve efficiency.

- 

Manage additional paid channels as needed, including Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Microsoft Ads.

Performance Ownership

- 

Own client performance across Google Ads, Meta, Microsoft and organic search channels.

- 

Audit existing PPC campaigns, keyword strategies, bidding structures, landing pages and CRO opportunities.

- 

Ensure KPI tracking, conversion attribution and analytics accuracy across every account.

Execution Oversight

- 

Provide weekly direction and QA for campaign optimizations and deliverables from specialists and contractors.

- 

Coordinate priorities with the Marketing PM to keep timelines and client expectations aligned.

Reporting and Communication

- 

Prepare monthly and quarterly performance reports with clear takeaways and next-step recommendations.

- 

Present performance summaries directly to clients.

- 

Oversee reporting accuracy and insights delivered by the PM or specialists.

Qualifications
Required

- 

5+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns, with first-party data proving results (CTR, CPL, ROAS, rankings).

- 

4 to 7 years of experience in PPC, SEO or multi-channel full-funnel strategy, including experience managing paid and organic channels concurrently.

- 

Proficient in Google Ads Editor, Google Keyword Planner, GA4 and Google Search Console.

- 

Strong understanding of campaign structure, bidding strategy, optimization and ROI tracking.

- 

Ability to create and articulate strategic recommendations to clients and AEs.

- 

Demonstrated ability to oversee execution teams and manage deliverable quality.

- 

Strong analytical skills and the ability to diagnose performance issues quickly.

- 

Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a remote team environment.

Preferred

- 

Google Ads Certification.

- 

Agency experience managing multiple clients at once.

- 

Experience with Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and Microsoft Ads.

- 

Experience joining sales calls and influencing close rates.

- 

Familiarity with multifamily, real estate or high-intent lead generation.

- 

Understanding of landing page optimization and CRO

- 

Experience with project management tools such as Jira, ClickUp or Asana.

Who Succeeds in This Role

- 

People who can both think strategically and manage execution.

- 

People who can simplify complex marketing ideas for clients.

- 

People who own the results and take full accountability, good and bad.

- 

People who work well with distributed teams.

- 

People who enjoy building rather than inheriting polished systems.

What You Will Own from Day One

- 

All marketing performance and strategy across PPC

- 

The roadmap for each client.

- 

Direct management of paid search campaigns across the client portfolio.

- 

Reporting frameworks, playbooks and best practices.

- 

Supporting AEs on sales calls.

Position Title: Paid Media Specialist (Contractor)

 Location: Remote

Reports to: Sr. Director, Partnership Media

Role is from October 12th - December 30th, 2026

 #LI-CW1 

About the role

The Paid Media Specialist will be responsible for assisting in the  execution of boosting Creator posts on Instagram and TikTok, from start to finish, including but not limited to campaign set-up, targeting parameters, implementation of UTM tracking, reporting on campaign performance, etc, for brands in verticals such as Fashion, Beauty, Big-Box retailers, retail media networks, etc. 

The ideal candidate will have 3+ years of digital media experience, specifically paid social, including but not limited to META, and TIKTOK. This candidate will manage and coordinate budgets, planning calendars,  assets, materials and approvals. 

Role requires marketing knowledge with creativity and passion to deliver bar-raising, best-in-class digital marketing.

The ideal candidate will have experience implementing and managing paid social campaigns, working closely with creator content, and influencer marketing campaigns, collaboration with sales departments, and  analyzing results and performance.

 

How you will make an impact

  • Develop, strategize, and execute creator boosting campaigns against targeted audiences from ideation to post campaign analysis
  • Facilitate teams campaign operations and workflow deadlines, deliverables and processes to ensure successful and on-time campaign execution
  • Support the Marketing team by monitoring KPIs (such as website traffic, top-of-funnel conversions, ads performance, and revenue) and informing on findings
  • Perform analysis of key business metrics to evaluate success and growth opportunities
  • Coordinate boosting efforts with Campaign Operations team

Key Measures:

  • Effectively manage Media Boosting on META and TIKTOK driving significant incremental traffic through boosted posts that beat industry standard media buy click through rates.
  • Drive incremental revenue by supporting sales in growing existing client relationships, revenue streams and total revenue.
  • Achievement of marketing implementation and success metrics
  • Disciplined campaign development and execution
  • Contributing to a robust and scalable funnel that grows relationships and revenue streams and overall revenue from existing clients
  • Able to report on performance, with understanding of multi-touch attribution modeling and experience sharing insights across teams.

 

What you will bring to LTK

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing or Communications;
  •  3+ years of experience with paid social media, for DTC/B2C brands. Hands on keyboard, implementation, and execution of campaigns is a must. 
  • Base knowledge of UTM parameters. 
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize and collaborate to meet deadlines in a dynamic fast-paced environment
  • A mindset focused on seizing opportunities and moving with urgency
  • Dedication to fierce prioritization and operational excellence
  • Adaptability to a dynamic, fast-moving environment
  • A growth mindset and openness to feedback

What we offer for full-time salaried employees

  • The opportunity to be part of the leading global company in creator commerce
  • A remote-first, productivity-first environment
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package to meet the needs of you and your family
  • 401(k) with LTK company matching
  • Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance, Dental Insurance
  • Paid Maternity Leave and Paid Paternity Leave
  • Summer Fridays and Flexible PTO
  • For temporary full-time employees, benefits eligibility may vary

About LTK

Founded in 2011, LTK is the global technology platform purpose-built to empower lifestyle creators to monetize their content. The full-service platform connects brands, creators, and shoppers with a world-class shopping app and trusted tools and technology that make content instantly shoppable. Today, premium lifestyle creators in 160+ countries drive more than $5 billion+ in annual retail sales through their LTK Shop profiles. More than 40 million consumers turn to LTK Shops in the LTK shopping platform each month to find inspiration and instantly shop the styles recommended by their favorite creators. More than 8,000 retailers and 1M brands partner with LTK to gain access to its global creator network for content that converts against performance-driven, cross-channel KPIs. LTK is headquartered in Dallas, TX, and currently operates on five continents.

Our mission

To empower the world’s premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success.

Our values

  • Here to win
  • Commit to the journey
  • Work well

Commitment to diversity

LTK believes diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental obligations that strengthen our team. We employ a diverse, multi-disciplinary team to build a meaningful company and culture. 

For US-Based Roles:  We are not offering new sponsorships opportunities at this time for persons requiring employment visas, such as an H-1B;  authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.

Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of LTK are considered the property of LTK and are not subject to payment of agency fees.

LTK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. #LI-Remote

record.Gecko Job Description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

### About the role

LemFi exists to serve people the financial world has largely ignored. Every campaign we run is a chance to reach a diaspora customer who needs a faster, fairer way to send money home, save in multiple currencies, or access credit for the first time. Performance marketing is not a support function here - it is one of the sharpest levers we have for scaling into new corridors and deepening product adoption in the markets we already serve.

As Senior Performance Marketing Manager, you will own paid acquisition end to end across our core channels and geographies. You will set strategy, run the numbers, brief the creatives, and be accountable for CAC, ROAS and volume targets - not just the dashboards that report them. You will work closely with Product, Growth, Creative and Data to make sure every pound, dollar or naira of media spend earns its place. If you treat a budget like it is your own money, read the data before forming an opinion, and push through the noise to find what actually moves the needle, this role is for you.

### What you'll build and own

- 

Own paid media strategy and execution across Meta, Google, TikTok and programmatic, covering customer acquisition and product cross-sell across LemFi's active markets.

- 

Manage and optimise significant media budgets with a clear eye on CAC, LTV, ROAS and payback periods - make the numbers work, not just look good in a report.

- 

Design and run a rigorous test-and-learn programme across audience segmentation, creative angles, bidding strategies and landing pages, using AI tools to accelerate analysis and iteration.

- 

Translate campaign data into clear, actionable insight for senior stakeholders - lead with what it means and what to do next, not just what happened.

- 

Partner with the Creative team to brief and iterate on paid assets that speak plainly to diaspora audiences across different corridors and cultures, cutting through the noise in crowded feeds.

- 

Work cross-functionally with Product and Growth to align paid campaigns with product launches, corridor expansions and seasonal remittance peaks, so spend lands when it matters most.

- 

Develop and maintain attribution and measurement frameworks that give the business confidence in channel contribution, flagging gaps and pushing for better data where it does not yet exist.

### Your experience

- 

5+ years of experience in performance marketing for a mobile app product, with a proven track record of managing substantial paid media budgets across at least Meta and Google, ideally within a high-growth consumer fintech, payments, or marketplace business.

- 

Full-funnel approach to growth, naturally thinking beyond acquisition and considering the entire customer lifecycle.

- 

Hands-on experience acquiring and retaining users for a mobile app product (iOS and Android), including working with mobile measurement partners, attribution tooling and incrementality testing.

- 

Demonstrably strong analytical skills - you move fluently between a campaign dashboard, a spreadsheet model and a conversation with a data analyst, and you know when instinct must give way to evidence.

- 

Ability to write a sharp creative brief and give structured feedback - you do not need to design, but you know what good looks like for a paid social ad.

- 

Comfort working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where priorities shift and you are expected to figure things out without a large supporting team.

- 

A genuine bias for action - you spot a problem or an opportunity, form a view, and move without waiting for permission to test.

### Nice to have

- 

Experience running paid campaigns in emerging markets across Africa, the Middle East or South Asia, with an understanding of how channel mix and creative norms differ from Western markets.

- 

Familiarity with AI-powered creative testing or media planning tools, and a habit of using them to do more with less.

- 

Exposure to multi-product growth loops - for example using remittance acquisition as an entry point to drive adoption of Savings, Credit or eSIM products.

## 
Why Join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play. 

## Recruitment Agencies Notice

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

# About Lunar Solar Group:  

Lunar Solar Group is a high-impact advertising agency that collaborates with consumer-focused brands to identify growth opportunities and implement disruptive marketing strategies. We combine digital marketing expertise and a suite of creative services to help brands scale. As a globally recognized growth consultancy, technology studio, and full-service digital marketing agency, we solve complex growth challenges and build brands through proprietary technology, innovative strategy, channel expertise, and flawless execution. Lunar has built a track record of excellence across various verticals, including durable goods, consumer packaged goods, and SaaS. While highlighting potential growth opportunities for clients, Lunar itself continues to expand rapidly.

At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.
 
With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work. 
 
At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.
 
Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.
 
 
**Travel to Office expectations**
For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.
 
For Hybrid Roles: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.

- Data Pipelines & Integrations: Design, build, and maintain data pipelines connecting Salesforce, Marketo, and the data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery) to support marketing performance reporting.

- Reporting Automation & Analytics Enablement: Automate recurring campaign reporting workflows and write/optimize SQL to build reusable datasets, views, and queries that power dashboards and leadership reporting.

- Campaign Attribution & Data Quality: Strengthen campaign attribution logic (campaign codes, UTM/campaign member data, lead-to-opportunity linkage) and monitor, troubleshoot, and improve data quality across Marketo, Salesforce, and downstream reporting tables.

- AI-Enabled Analytics Workflows: Apply AI tools such as Claude to accelerate data exploration, documentation, and query development, while maintaining rigor and accuracy in production reporting.

- Systems Support & Documentation: Support backend administration and configuration in Salesforce and Marketo (fields, objects, sync rules, campaign structures), and document data models, definitions, and processes so metrics stay consistent and self-serve for marketing stakeholders.

- Bachelor's degree (completed or in final year) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related technical field. New graduates are encouraged to apply.

- 0 – 2 years of applicable experience.

- Strong SQL skills: comfortable writing joins, aggregations, and window functions against large relational datasets.

- Working knowledge of at least one programming language used in data work (e.g., Python) for scripting, automation, or ETL.

- Understanding of relational data models and how CRM/marketing-automation data is structured (leads, contacts, accounts, campaigns, opportunities).

- Highly analytical and detail-oriented, with a strong bias toward automating repetitive work.

- Intellectually curious and open-minded, with a genuine thirst to learn new tools, systems, and business context.

- Hands-on exposure to Salesforce (SOQL, reports, campaign objects, admin concepts) or Marketo (programs, smart campaigns, field sync).

- Experience with a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift) and BI tools (Power BI, Looker, Tableau).

- Familiarity with AI-assisted development or analytics tools, such as Claude or similar large language model platforms.

- Exposure to ETL/ELT tooling, APIs, or workflow orchestration (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Fivetran, or equivalent scripting).

- Familiarity with marketing funnel metrics (MQLs, opportunities, pipeline) or B2B demand generation.

- Co-op, internship, or project experience in a data engineering, analytics engineering, or revenue operations context.

 PointClickCare Benefits & Perks:
 
Benefits starting from Day 1!
Retirement Plan Matching 
Flexible Paid Time Off
Wellness Support Programs and Resources
Parental & Caregiver Leaves
Fertility & Adoption Support
Continuous Development Support Program
Employee Assistance Program 
Allyship and Inclusion Communities
Employee Recognition … and more!

PointClickCare welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Please contact recruitment@pointclickcare.com should you require any accommodations. As part of our commitment to a streamlined and equitable hiring experience, PointClickCare uses AI tools to assist with candidate screening and assessment.
 
When you apply for a position, your information is processed and stored with Lever, in accordance with Lever’s Privacy Policy. We use this information to evaluate your candidacy for the posted position. We also store this information, and may use it in relation to future positions to which you apply, or which we believe may be relevant to you given your background. When we have no ongoing legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it.  If you have any questions about how PointClickCare uses or processes your information, or if you would like to ask to access, correct, or delete your information, please contact PointClickCare’s human resources team: recruitment@pointclickcare.com

Digital Strategist Account Manager 

📍 USA & Canada. Remote or in-person SF.

⏰ Working hours are PST

## About Valid

Founded in July 2023, Valid is a seed-stage company operating at Series A scale, headquartered in San Francisco.

In under two years, we’ve grown from 5 people to 40+, deployed over $1B in ad spend, and built a full-stack, tech-enabled advertising company serving enterprise consumer customers.

We’re well-capitalized and backed by top Silicon Valley investors including Canaan, Neo, and others.

## This Role is for you if you are:

- 

A consumer obsessed full-funnel marketing strategist

- 

First in line to try the newest AI marketing tools

- 

Well versed in navigating the Ads Managers for the main paid social and search ad platforms, leveraging the latest tools/features

- 

Run campaigns focused on sales, CPAs and ROAS, not traffic and awareness.

- 

Passionate about ad networks and performance marketing strategy for consumer digital products

- 

Obsessed with discovering and tracking social media trends

- 

Customer obsessed (we put it in their twice on purpose!)

- 

Focused on paid media, we don’t do SEO or other digital paths, we are 100% focused on ROI-based ads.

- 

Preferred: savvy on app growth marketing for iOS and app user acquisition.

We believe that the best form of marketing is AI-assisted, data-driven and human in-the-loop. This role is for an account manager who can help set strategy based on a clients needs and business objectives.

## Role & Responsibilities

Digital Strategy (30% of your time)

- 

Understand a client’s business objectives and KPIs

- 

Define strategy for the account based on budget and objectives

- 

Analyze results and in market trends to devise the best path forward

- 

Manage a team of marketers to use tooling you to deliver a best-in-class ads experience

Account Management (60% of your time)

- 

Interface directly with clients on a weekly basis

- 

Present reports, give update on campaigns, give guidance on using Valid tools and assistance on media related queries

- 

Be the clients first and primary point of contact at Valid

Product (10% of your time)

- 

Interface directly with engineering & PMs to translate marketing processes into real products

## Required Qualifications

- 

Strong english and client-facing communication skills

- 

5+ years of performance marketing experience with at least 2+ years of full-funnel performance marketing experience within an agency

- 

Manage +$150,000/month of ad spend across the following platforms:

- 

Meta

- 

TikTok

- 

Google

- 

Other advertising channels

- 

Comfortable analyzing data and deploying statistical methods to “read the tea leaves” of an ad account.

- 

Served in client facing roles as senior POC

Nice to Have

- 

Managed and hired a team of marketers

- 

Advertising for mobile apps:

- 

Experience with MMPs (Adjust, Appsflyer, AirBridge, Singular, etc.)

- 

AppleSearchAds

- 

Understand SKAN and iOS attribution

- 

Experience with in-app growth analytics (tools like RevenueCat, Adapty, Mixpanel/Amplitude)

You’re Probably a Good Fit If:

- 

Applying the latest tech in novel ways to delight customers excites you

- 

Your goal is to maximize ownership

- 

You want to join something early stage

- 

The idea of organized chaos is what you want

- 

Organized: Build with purpose, work efficiently, communicate clearly, especially in writing.

- 

Chaos: We think the best place to learn is in market and will do what it takes to ship as quickly as possible.

## What You’ll Be Getting

- 

Work on a global team with flexibility and a collaborative startup culture

- 

Annual company offsite - we gather in a new location each year to connect and celebrate

## Compensation Range

- 

Competitive salary based on experience and location

- 

Benefits: 401k, healthcare, FSA, lunch (for in-person days)

- 

Location: Remote friendly in USA or Canada with a preference for in-person out of our office in San Francisco.
