record.Gecko Job Description:
CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs.
Location: Remote (USA or Canada)

CSC Generation is looking for a Vice President of Performance Marketing to own paid media strategy and the paid media P&L across our portfolio of 13 brands, including Sur La Table, Backcountry, and One Kings Lane. As Vice President, Performance Marketing, you will set multi-year direction, build the team and agency bench to execute against it, and represent performance marketing on CSC Generation's leadership team.

In your first year, success means establishing a unified performance marketing strategy across the portfolio, standing up the right team structure, and demonstrating measurable improvement in blended CAC and media efficiency. You will partner closely with Creative, Merchandising, and eCommerce leadership to ensure paid investment, assortment, and creative strategy reinforce each other.

This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

#### Performance Marketing Strategy

- Own the performance marketing P&L and multi-year strategy across the brand portfolio, spanning paid search, paid social, shopping/feed, display, affiliate, video/TV, and emerging channels.

- Set channel and budget allocation based on incrementality, LTV, and blended CAC targets, and defend those trade-offs to the executive team.

- Translate company revenue and margin targets into a multi-year paid media investment plan.

- Build repeatable playbooks for launches, promotions, and seasonal peaks that scale across brands.

- Track competitor activity and market trends to spot new channels, formats, and positioning opportunities.

#### Team Leadership & Organization

- Build and lead a team of performance marketing leaders and specialists, plus supporting agencies.

- Set operating standards for testing velocity, reporting rigor, and channel expertise, and hold your leadership team accountable to them.

- Stay close enough to the numbers to catch problems early, coach through them, and step in directly when needed.

- Hold agency partners accountable to performance benchmarks, media efficiency, and clear scopes of work.

- Own new channel expansion, including hands-on execution of initial campaigns in new channels.

- Champion a continuous A/B and multivariate testing culture across creative, landing pages, and audience targeting, turning results into scaled learnings.

- Drive adoption and demonstrated use of AI and automation tools across the team to improve decisions, increase output, and free up time for high-value work.

#### Executive & Cross-Functional Leadership

- Sit on CSC Generation's marketing leadership team and represent performance marketing in company-level strategy and planning.

- Partner with Creative to ensure ad concepts and assets are built for performance from the start.

- Partner with Merchandising to align paid spend with inventory, margin, and assortment priorities.

- Partner with eCommerce, Product, and Web Development to ensure landing pages, site experience, and conversion funnels support paid traffic quality.

- Translate performance data into clear commercial recommendations for the executive team—not just channel-level metrics.

Paid Media Buyer

Location: Fully Remote 

Job Type: Full-Time

 

About the role

We're hiring a Paid Media Buyer to live inside our ad accounts across Meta, TikTok, and AppLovin, while helping us expand across additional channels including Snapchat, X/Twitter, Google/YouTube, native, and other emerging platforms. You'll own the technical execution and day-to-day optimization of paid campaigns: building structure, reading the data, finding the leaks, and pulling the right levers to scale.

This is a performance ownership role. You won’t be creating assets yourself, but you’ll work closely with creative teams to understand why ads win, identify performance patterns, and turn data into better creative decisions.

Must-Have Platform Experience

Candidates must have hands-on, performance marketing experience with:

- 

Meta

- 

TikTok

- 

AppLovin

You should be comfortable independently building, launching, optimizing, and scaling campaigns across all three platforms.

Nice-to-Have Platform Experience

Additional experience with any of the following is a plus:

- 

Snapchat

- 

Twitter/X

- 

Google/YouTube

- 

Native advertising, including Taboola and Outbrain

Ideal Background

The strongest candidates for this role have scaled DTC/ecommerce brands through Meta-first performance marketing environments where they owned significant spend, testing, optimization, and business outcomes.

You likely come from a high-growth consumer brand or performance marketing agency where you managed multiple direct-response ecommerce accounts and had direct responsibility for profitable scale.

Strong signals:

- 

Managed $750K–$1M+ monthly paid media spend

- 

Deep Meta Ads expertise as the primary growth channel

- 

Scaled DTC/ecommerce products through paid acquisition

- 

Owned budget allocation, testing strategy, and performance decisions

- 

Experience working closely with creative teams to turn data into winning ads

 

What you'll do

Daily / Weekly Cadence

- 

Run weekly account optimizations across every platform you own. Increase budgets on ad sets and campaigns hitting their primary KPI over rolling 3/7/14-day windows, pull back spend from underperformers, and restart ads where delayed attribution masked early performance.

- 

Maintain a weekly creative testing cadence per platform: brief tests, launch with clean hypotheses, read them against pre-set spend or conversion thresholds, then kill or scale on schedule.

- 

Run pacing checks daily, weekly, and MTD against budget and KPI goals. Adjust spend distribution before the gap becomes a problem, not after.

- 

On Google specifically: negative keyword mining on Search and Shopping, smart bidding strategy reviews, Merchant Center diagnostics, quality score and ad strength reviews, and placement exclusions on Display and YouTube.

- 

Lead routine reporting (weekly and monthly) for the accounts you own. Performance, leading indicators, blended view across platforms, and the insights and next moves, not just the numbers.

Strategic Ownership

- 

Build, launch, and optimize campaigns across Meta, TikTok, Applovin,  as core acquisition channels

- 

Support and help scale additional channels including Snapchat, Twitter/X, Google/YouTube, native, and new platforms we test into.

- 

Continuously audit accounts. Spot bottlenecks at the ad level vs. the site level, kill waste, double down on what's working.

- 

Read multi-platform data and explain what's actually happening, not just what each platform reports about itself.

- 

Make the call on how to allocate budget across platforms based on incrementality, scale capacity, and unit economics.

- 

Brief creative needs to the creative team based on data signal, then test outputs against pre-defined success criteria.

 

Tools you'll use

- 

Native ad platforms: Meta Ads Manager, ApplLovin, Google Ads, NewsBreak, Pinterest Ads, Taboola/Outbrain

- 

Analytics: GA4, Northbeam, Hex, BigQuery, Shopify backend

- 

Planning and reporting: Notion, ClickUp, Sheets/Excel

Equivalents are fine. We care about the muscle, not the brand of the tool.

 

What we're looking for

- 

3+ years buying paid media at meaningful scale ($750K–$1M+ monthly preferred), with hands-on Meta as the foundation

- 

Hands-on Meta, TikTok, and AppLovin experience is required

- 

Meta-first paid acquisition expertise: Deep Meta Ads expertise with Google Ads experience as a plus.

- 

Experience scaling DTC/ecommerce brands through paid acquisition

- 

Experience operating in direct-response environments where spend efficiency and creative performance drive growth

- 

Strong analytical chops: at home in Sheets/Excel, can pull the right view in Looker Studio or equivalent, and read a P&L well enough to translate ad metrics into business impact

- 

Comfort with attribution chaos: you can reconcile what Meta says, what Shopify says, and what GA4 says, and explain it to a CFO without hand-waving

- 

Sharp on tracking and measurement: pixels, CAPI, server-side events, conversion APIs, UTMs

- 

A clear point of view on testing: how to design clean tests, when to call a winner, when to kill a loser

- 

Deep curiosity around performance: constantly asks why something worked or failed, identifies patterns, and turns insights into action.

- 

Strong written communication: Slack updates, weekly performance reports, ad-hoc explanations to non-paid-media stakeholders

- 

Asks the right questions before acting. We'll trust you with real money in real accounts; you need to know what you don't know, and ask for it

- 

Comfortable juggling multiple accounts in parallel with shifting priorities, without dropping balls

 

Nice to have

- 

Snapchat paid media experience

- 

Twitter/X paid media experience

- 

Google Ads and YouTube experience

- 

Native advertising experience, including Taboola / Outbrain

- 

Mobile UA experience

- 

MMM / incrementality testing experience

- 

Server-side tracking setup experience

- 

Shopify / ecommerce analytics depth

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

💻 Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (not digital nomad)

📊 Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)

 

Benefits & Compensation

- 

Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure

- 

Fully remote - work from anywhere in the US, Canada, or Europe

- 

Paid time off

- 

Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire

- 

Fully covered medical insurance, including health, dental, and vision. (US-based employees)

- 

Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy

- 

Professional development - opportunities to learn and grow with the business

 

Ready to Apply?

If you're a performance-driven media buyer who knows Meta, TikTok, and AppLovin inside and out, understands how creative and media buying work together, and wants ownership over meaningful spend in a high-output, high-accountability environment, apply now.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Manager, Marketing Analytics (Multi-Touch Attribution) based in the United States.

This is an opportunity to lead sophisticated marketing measurement engagements for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and life sciences clients, helping them understand how customer interactions influence prescription outcomes. As a Manager of Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), you will oversee end-to-end analytics projects, from data integration and methodology design to strategic recommendations and marketing budget optimization. You will combine advanced statistical modeling, causal inference, and omnichannel analytics to evaluate the impact of field detailing, digital campaigns, email, paid media, congresses, and medical education. Working closely with commercial, brand, and marketing operations leaders, you will translate complex analytical findings into actionable business decisions. You will also lead and mentor a team of consultants and analysts while strengthening analytical quality, reproducibility, and methodological innovation. This full-time opportunity is well suited to a data-driven leader who combines technical expertise, client consulting skills, and a strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercial strategy.

- 

Lead client attribution engagements: Manage multi-touch attribution projects from initial scoping through final delivery, establishing project timelines, budgets, success criteria, and stakeholder expectations.

- 

Develop attribution methodologies: Design and implement attribution frameworks using rules-based, probabilistic, and algorithmic approaches, including Markov chains, Shapley values, logistic regression, and Bayesian models. Clearly document assumptions, limitations, and methodological choices.

- 

Integrate and reconcile data: Combine prescription and claims data, CRM and field call activity, digital and email engagement, media delivery, samples, and market access data while maintaining applicable patient and healthcare professional privacy standards.

- 

Apply omnichannel measurement expertise: Incorporate marketing mix (MMx) and omnichannel analytics to understand how different promotional channels and customer interactions contribute to business outcomes.

- 

Triangulate measurement results: Compare MTA findings with marketing mix modeling (MMM), geographic analyses, holdout experiments, incrementality testing, and other measurement approaches to develop a robust view of channel performance.

- 

Translate insights into recommendations: Present clear, actionable findings to executive stakeholders, including channel return on investment, customer journey sequencing, campaign effectiveness, and budget reallocation opportunities.

- 

Maintain analytical excellence: Oversee code quality, model validation, documentation, and reproducibility across analytical projects, ensuring results are rigorous, reliable, and clearly communicated.

- 

Lead and develop the team: Manage, coach, and mentor consultants and analysts, including workload planning, performance feedback, professional development, and capability building.

- 

Support business development and innovation: Contribute to proposals, thought leadership, methodological improvements, and reusable analytical tools and accelerators.

- 

Ensure regulatory compliance: Maintain adherence to applicable regulations and internal standards, including the PhRMA Code, OPDP guidance, HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, and other relevant privacy requirements.

### Requirements:

- 

Relevant professional experience: At least 6 years of experience in marketing analytics, measurement, or data science, including a minimum of 3 years in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or life sciences.

- 

Multi-touch attribution expertise: Demonstrated experience designing and delivering MTA or equivalent customer journey analytics projects.

- 

Technical proficiency: Strong SQL skills and proficiency in at least one of Python or R, with practical experience in cloud data environments such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery.

- 

Statistical and measurement knowledge: Strong understanding of statistical modeling, causal inference, and experimental design, including the strengths and limitations of MTA, MMM, and incrementality testing.

- 

Pharmaceutical commercial data experience: Working knowledge of industry data sources such as IQVIA, Symphony, and Veeva CRM, as well as pharmaceutical promotional channels and commercial operations.

- 

Marketing measurement expertise: Understanding of MMx and omnichannel analytics, with the ability to connect customer interactions, promotional strategies, and commercial outcomes.

- 

Leadership experience: Proven experience leading or mentoring a team of at least three people, ideally in a client-service or consulting environment.

- 

Client-facing communication: Ability to present complex analytical findings to senior stakeholders, influence decisions without direct authority, and adapt communications for technical and executive audiences.

- 

Educational background: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or business-related discipline, such as statistics, economics, engineering, mathematics, or marketing analytics. An advanced degree is preferred.

- 

Preferred qualifications: Experience with commercial measurement platforms or third-party MTA tools; familiarity with patient journey analytics, omnichannel orchestration, or next-best-action frameworks; and experience in consulting, agency, or analytics vendor environments.

- 

Additional advantages: Publications, conference presentations, or thought leadership contributions related to attribution and marketing measurement.

- 

Core competencies: Analytical rigor, critical thinking, sound client judgment, business acumen, clear communication, effective team leadership, and the ability to evaluate uncertainty and balance methodological precision with practical business needs.

-

Strong ownership, initiative, prioritization, and decision-making skills in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

Comfort working independently, managing ambiguity, responding to platform volatility, and meeting demanding deadlines.

A proactive mindset, with a willingness to experiment, challenge assumptions, and continuously improve campaign performance.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Demand Generation Manager (Paid Media) based in the United States.

Join an innovative technology environment at the intersection of AI, cloud infrastructure, and global connectivity, where marketing is powered by intelligent automation and data-driven decision-making. As the Senior Demand Generation Manager, you will build and lead a dedicated demand generation program from the ground up, with ownership of strategy, budget, and measurable business outcomes. You will manage full-funnel paid media campaigns across search, social, programmatic advertising, and emerging AI-powered advertising channels. Working with advanced AI agents, you will combine automated campaign execution with strategic judgment to optimize performance, improve efficiency, and scale growth. You will also lead account-based marketing initiatives, develop creator partnerships, and collaborate closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Product Marketing. This role offers significant autonomy, access to cutting-edge AI tools, and the opportunity to shape how modern B2B marketing operates. Success will be measured by your ability to generate qualified pipeline, drive product activations, and contribute directly to revenue growth.

- Lead paid media strategy and execution: Plan, launch, manage, and optimize full-funnel campaigns across search, social, programmatic, and emerging AI advertising platforms, overseeing campaign quality assurance, budget pacing, creative refreshes, and landing page performance across channels and regions.

- Build AI-powered marketing operations: Direct a fleet of autonomous AI agents that support campaign management and optimization. Develop and refine prompts, evaluate machine-generated recommendations and confidence scores, manage approval workflows, and determine when human intervention is necessary.

- Own budget allocation and performance: Manage monthly budgets across advertising platforms, monitor spending, reallocate investment based on performance data, and maintain disciplined budget controls and transparent spending records.

- Optimize campaigns continuously: Conduct weekly performance reviews, identify creative fatigue, analyze search terms and audience segments, diagnose acquisition costs and funnel performance, and make data-backed decisions about scaling or discontinuing campaigns.

- Drive account-based marketing (ABM): Define ideal customer profiles, develop target account lists, build audience segments and Salesforce account pools, coordinate regional campaigns with Sales, and ensure targeting data remains accurate and synchronized across advertising platforms.

- Align cross-functional teams: Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Product Marketing to review high-priority accounts, analyze wins and losses, improve lead routing and attribution, and refine positioning and messaging using paid media insights.

- Manage influencer and creator initiatives: Identify relevant creators, develop campaign briefs, coordinate sponsorships, amplify creator content through paid media, and measure audience engagement and conversion outcomes.

- Deliver actionable reporting: Provide weekly and monthly performance updates to marketing, sales, and executive stakeholders, communicating results clearly, identifying opportunities, and recommending concrete next steps.

- Build and scale a new growth program: Establish the strategy, processes, channel mix, and operating standards for a dedicated marketing program, using AI automation and continuous experimentation to improve efficiency and business impact.

## Requirements

- Relevant experience: At least 5 years of experience in B2B demand generation, ideally within developer tools, cloud infrastructure, telecommunications, or another technical B2B market.

- Paid media expertise: Demonstrated hands-on experience managing full-funnel paid media campaigns across at least three major advertising platforms, with a strong understanding of acquisition, conversion, and performance optimization.

- AI and automation proficiency: Practical experience using AI agents or automated workflows in marketing operations. You should be comfortable writing precise prompts, critically evaluating AI-generated recommendations, and designing workflows in which AI handles execution while people retain appropriate oversight.

- Account-based marketing: Proven experience developing and executing ABM campaigns, including account targeting, audience segmentation, and measurable pipeline generation.

- Data analysis and attribution: Strong analytical skills and the ability to reconcile advertising platform conversion data with CRM and attribution reporting. You must be comfortable challenging unreliable metrics and making decisions based on validated performance data.

- Budget ownership: Experience managing marketing budgets, adjusting channel investment, monitoring acquisition costs, and connecting spending decisions to pipeline, activation, and revenue outcomes.

- Strategic and operational ownership: The ability to build programs from scratch, navigate ambiguity, establish effective processes, and take responsibility for measurable results.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with Sales, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, and other teams.

- Continuous optimization mindset: A structured, experimental approach to marketing, with the ability to identify opportunities, test new ideas, learn from results, and scale successful initiatives.

- Adaptability and innovation: Enthusiasm for emerging advertising technologies, AI agents, agentic runtimes, frontier AI models, and new approaches to demand generation.

## Benefits

- Competitive compensation: A dedicated budget and direct ownership of marketing investment, with performance evaluated against meaningful business outcomes. A specific salary range was not provided in the original job description.

- Significant ownership: Build a new demand generation program from the ground up, with autonomy over strategy, channel selection, budget allocation, and execution.

- Cutting-edge AI technology: Work directly with advanced AI agents, agentic runtimes, frontier models, voice AI, and inference APIs as part of your daily marketing workflow.

- Early access to new tools: Experiment with emerging AI technologies and contribute feedback that can influence how tools and workflows evolve.

- AI-powered marketing infrastructure: Benefit from an existing fleet of AI agents that handles campaign operations, allowing you to focus on strategic decisions, performance, and growth.

- High-impact work: Own a full-funnel marketing program and contribute directly to pipeline generation, product activations, and revenue.

- Collaborative environment: Work alongside experienced professionals who manage their own marketing programs and share responsibility for business results.

- Professional development: Gain hands-on experience at the intersection of demand generation, AI automation, and modern technology infrastructure.

### Performance Marketing Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
 Working Hours: U.S. Time Zone
 Location: Remote (Pakistan, LATAM, South Africa, Philippines Preferred)

### About the Role

We are seeking a highly analytical and execution-focused Performance Marketing Specialist to develop, manage, and optimize paid marketing campaigns across multiple digital advertising platforms.

This role is ideal for a data-driven marketer who understands how to build scalable acquisition systems while balancing creativity, experimentation, and ROI optimization. You will oversee campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and additional paid channels, ensuring every campaign is optimized for measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments, understands full-funnel marketing, and continuously improves campaign performance through testing, analytics, and strategic optimization.

### What You’ll Own

### Campaign Strategy & Execution

• Develop and manage performance-driven advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other paid platforms
 • Plan and execute campaigns focused on lead generation, customer acquisition, sales, and brand growth
 • Create, test, and optimize ad creatives, messaging, audience targeting, and campaign structures
 • Collaborate with marketing, content, and creative teams to ensure alignment across campaigns and brand messaging
 • Manage campaign launches, scaling initiatives, and ongoing optimization efforts

### Optimization & Growth

• Monitor campaign performance daily and identify optimization opportunities
 • Conduct A/B testing across creatives, audiences, landing pages, and bidding strategies
 • Optimize budgets, bids, placements, and targeting to improve ROAS and reduce CPA/CPL
 • Experiment with new campaign formats, acquisition strategies, and audience segments
 • Stay updated on advertising platform updates, algorithm changes, and industry best practices

### Analytics & Reporting

• Track and analyze KPIs including CTR, CPC, CPA, CPL, ROAS, conversion rates, and funnel performance
 • Use Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and advertising dashboards to evaluate campaign effectiveness
 • Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights and optimization recommendations
 • Identify trends, attribution insights, and opportunities for scalable growth through data analysis

### Funnel & Conversion Strategy

• Understand and optimize the full customer acquisition funnel from ad click through conversion
 • Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to improve lead quality and conversion performance
 • Support landing page optimization and conversion-focused marketing initiatives
 • Ensure campaigns align with broader business growth and revenue objectives

### Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with design, content, sales, and marketing teams to improve campaign outcomes
 • Provide data-backed feedback on ad creatives, messaging, and conversion assets
 • Contribute to integrated marketing strategies across paid, organic, and outbound channels

### What Makes You a Great Fit

• Data-driven marketer who enjoys testing, analyzing, and optimizing campaigns
 • Strong understanding of performance marketing and customer acquisition funnels
 • Analytical thinker with the ability to turn campaign data into actionable growth strategies
 • Organized and detail-oriented while managing multiple campaigns simultaneously
 • Proactive problem-solver focused on continuous improvement and scalability
 • Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution

### Required Experience & Skills

• 3+ years of hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns
 • Proven experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or related paid platforms
 • Strong understanding of PPC, attribution models, conversion tracking, and paid funnel optimization
 • Experience using Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and related reporting tools
 • Proven ability to improve ROAS, reduce CPA/CPL, and scale campaigns profitably
 • Strong communication, project management, and organizational skills

### Preferred Experience

• Experience with both Lead Generation and E-commerce campaigns
 • Familiarity with CRM and automation tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Marketo
 • Understanding of funnel marketing, audience segmentation, and lifecycle marketing
 • Google Ads or Meta Ads certifications
 • Experience managing multiple accounts or client portfolios

# Campaigns & Memberships Marketing Manager 

## Company description:

Elliptic is the leader in digital asset decisioning, we have built the most comprehensive platform for efficiently extracting crypto data and intelligence across blockchains with the greatest accuracy.

Our platform’s unrivalled uptime, scalability, depth and breadth of our data and intelligence means exacting organisations choose Elliptic for their compliance, risk management, intelligence operations and blockchain infrastructure needs.

Founded in 2013, Elliptic is headquartered in London with offices in New York, Washington D.C., Miami, San Francisco, UAE, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo. To learn more, visit www.elliptic.co and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

## The Role 

We’re looking for a data-driven marketer with a passion for delivering impactful, integrated campaigns and for maximizing the value of key industry partnerships. This is a high-impact role for someone ready to take full ownership of campaign delivery and continuously optimize engagement across the buyer journey.

## The impact you will have:

Elliptic is at an inflection point, shifting from crypto compliance tool to data and AI intelligence platform. This role puts you at the centre of that story. You will own the campaign engine that moves prospects through the buyer journey across our four core segments: financial institutions, PSPs, crypto natives, and government. You will also own the industry relationships that keep Elliptic visible and credible in the markets that matter. Done well, this role directly shapes the pipeline, not just awareness.

## What you will do:

Plan and execute integrated multi-channel campaigns from brief to measurement, with clear accountability for business contribution at each stage, from awareness to pipe generation.

- 

Own Elliptic's industry memberships and associations end to end: selecting the right ones, managing the relationships, and making sure each one delivers measurable return.

- 

Build and run a newsletter and nurture programme that earns its audience rather than just occupying inboxes.

- 

Design, build, and manage a data-driven newsletter and nurture programme that delivers engaging content and strengthens relationships with our audience.

- 

Own the social calendar with a clear point of view on what Elliptic should be saying and where.

- 

Partner with Field Marketing to adapt global campaigns for regional markets without losing precision.

- 

Brief the Creative team with rigour: clear audience, clear objective, clear measure of success.

- 

Partner with the Events team to ensure the success of global events and webinars - supporting end-to-end execution, driving registrations, and amplifying post-event impact.

- 

Work closely with the Content Strategist to identify gaps, develop high-performing assets and ensure that content supports each stage of the buyer lifecycle.

- 

Continuously explore new channels, creative approaches, and tools—using data to refine and strengthen campaign performance.

- 

Measure performance using marketing analytics. Present insights and actionable recommendations for improving campaign ROI and audience engagement.

- 

Use AI tools and modern marketing practices to streamline processes, increase productivity, and foster innovation.

## You will be a great fit if you:

- 

Take ownership of outcomes, not just activities. You care whether the campaign worked, not just whether it shipped.

- 

You are comfortable with data and use it to make decisions rather than to report backwards.

- 

You think in buyer journeys: you know how to move someone from unaware to in-conversation and you design accordingly.

- 

You have genuine curiosity about the crypto and digital assets space, not as a box to tick but because you find it interesting.

- 

You can work at pace without losing quality, and you hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is checking.

## Our ideal candidate has:

- 

Proven experience planning and executing integrated B2B campaigns with measurable pipeline impact.

- 

Strong working knowledge of HubSpot or an equivalent marketing automation platform.

- 

Experience managing industry partnerships or memberships with a commercial lens, not just an admin one.

- 

Solid understanding of LinkedIn, X, Reddit etc as B2B channels, including both organic and paid.

- 

Experience in a regulated sector, fintech, or crypto environment, or a strong, demonstrable interest in the space.

- 

Excellent written communication: clear, direct, and built for the channel it is on.

- 

Previous experience or knowledge of the crypto space or regulated sector

## How we work:

- 

Hybrid working and the option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year

- 

£500 Remote working budget to set up your home office space

> Learning & Development:

- 

£1,000 Learning & Development budget to use on anything (agreed with your manager) that contributes to your growth and development

> Vacation/ Leave:

- 

Holidays: 25 days of annual leave + bank holidays

- 

An extra day for your birthday

- 

Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave and leave.

> Benefits:

- 

Private Health Insurance - we use Bupa!

- 

Full access to Spill Mental Health Support

- 

Life Assurance: we hope you will never need this - but our cover is for 4 times your salary to your beneficiaries

- 

Cycle to Work Scheme

We know Diversity and Inclusion is much deeper than just hiring, but it’s important for us to mention it here.  We welcome and embrace individuals of all backgrounds and identities at Elliptic, and this is an ongoing priority for us.  We know incredible people don’t all think in the same way.  We want to be challenged every day.  We believe our diverse team of individuals underpins this by bringing creative thinking and innovation to Elliptic every day.  We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and equitable workplace, so we welcome applications from everyone, even if you may not think you fit all of the requirements of our roles.  We foster an environment of psychological safety, where everyone feels comfortable to bring their whole self to work.

About GenScript

Founded in 2002 in New Jersey, GenScript Biotech Corporation accelerates innovation in biotech and healthcare by providing researchers and companies with the building blocks needed to develop groundbreaking treatments and products. Guided by its mission to Make People and Nature Healthier Through Biotechnology, and its role as a well-recognized biotechnology company, GenScript has a team of approximately 6,165 employees and has served more than 200,000 customers across over 100 countries and regions.

Job Scope:

GenScript is seeking an Integrated Campaign Manager, Life Sciences Marketing to support the Integrated Communications & Content department. 

Reporting to: Associate Director, Marketing Campaigns. 

Location: Remote- United States

The estimated salary range is $100,000 - $130,000, based on experience level.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work with cross-functional teams on marketing briefs and in-depth customer understanding to transform business needs into marketing campaigns.
  • Provide insight-driven and targeted creative strategy and campaign planning, including target audience definition, creative ideation, omni-channel content development, and evaluation methods.
  • Oversea internal and external creative content creation (visuals, A/Vs, emails, social media, etc.) based on the creative strategy and planned timelines, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and business strategies.
  • Build the storytelling of the GenScript LSG brand across campaigns, ensuring consistency and strategic continuity through various forms of content amplified at multiple connection points.
  • Optimize the marketing campaign process and management tools to ensure the hi-quality and timely production/implementation of all campaign/event materials.
  • Monitor the progress and analyze the effectiveness of marketing campaigns, provide analysis reports and optimization suggestions.
  • Oversee the marketing campaigns team’s engagement, capability development and performance assessment while inspiring them.

Qualifications:

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above; educational background in life sciences, biotechnology, biomedical sciences, chemistry, biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline is highly preferred.
  2. 7+ years of professional experience, including at least 3+ years of experience in marketing campaign strategy, planning, and execution.
  3. Experience in the biotechnology, biomedical, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or related industries is highly preferred.
  4. Familiar with the process and methods of marketing campaign planning, execution and analysis, as well as with digital marketing channels and strategies.
  5. Experience planning and executing large-scale online and offline marketing campaigns, programs, and events is preferred.
  6. Strong market insight, analytical skills, and strategic thinking capabilities.
  7. Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, including product managers, regional managers, and media & connection team, to maximize campaign effectiveness.
  8. Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  9. Fluent spoken and written English, with excellent reading, writing, and presentation skills.

#LI-EB1

#GS

Benefits:

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as a 401(k) retirement plan with a company match that vests fully on day one. We offer paid parental leave after just three (3) months of employment, and a paid time off policy that includes vacation time, personal time, sick time, floating holidays, and company holidays. Additional benefits include flexible spending and health savings accounts, life and AD&D insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, legal assistance, and supplemental plans such as pet, critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance. We also provide commuter benefits, well-being initiatives, and peer-to-peer recognition programs; demonstrating our ongoing commitment to building a culture where our people feel empowered, supported, and inspired to do their best work.

GenScript USA Inc/ProBio Inc. is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to attracting, retaining, and maximizing the performance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the Company's policy to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, national origin, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, genetic information, citizenship status, uniformed service member or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

GenScript USA Inc./ProBio Inc. maintains a drug-free workplace.

We are a fully distributed company with team members located across North America, Latin America, and Europe. 

We’re obsessed with impact— it’s foundational to who we are, why we’re successful, and how we approach delivering outcomes for clients and ultimately, everyone on the internet. 

We seek an experienced Growth Director (SEO + AEO + Content) to lead growth strategies for high-growth tech companies. You will develop and execute SEO, AEO, content, and conversion optimization strategies to drive business results for our partners. Success requires strong problem-solving skills, creativity, and ownership of complex, large-scale projects.

This opportunity is full-time and fully remote, offering the flexibility to work from home.

Come join us and help us create the best content, everywhere that matters!

What you’ll do:

• Lead growth strategies for consumer tech companies.

• Own execution of web and app SEO/AEO projects.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve targets.

• Present insights and outcomes to executives.

• Develop data-driven, scalable content solutions.

What expertise you’ll need:

• 6+ years of technical and programmatic SEO experience or 6+ years of Digital Marketing experience with a keen interest in SEO.

• Strong leadership and communication skills.

• Proficient in data analysis and growth marketing tools (Google Analytics, SEMRush, Ahrefs).

•Experience with user acquisition and product development for web and mobile platforms.

Graphite’s mission is to create an environment where you build the best work of your career. In order to facilitate this, we provide:

Process As Needed - We view the process as a way to empower better work, not as a series of dogmatic rules. We develop the best internal processes the same way we develop products - through iteration, measurement, and continuous improvement.

Autonomy - We trust you to be excellent at what you do. We will provide as much support as needed when needed, but no more. You will have autonomy and agency to drive projects forward, and own decisions and outcomes.

Flexible Work Environment - Everyone’s optimal work style is unique. We operate as a distributed team across North & Latin America and Asia. We optimize for productivity and performance, not time spent in an office. Help us build an optimal work environment that fits you as an individual.

Compensation - We want to work with the best people in the World and compensate accordingly.

Vacation & Time Off - In order to be the best version of yourself, you need time to recharge. We offer flexible PTO. Take time when you need it.

Benefits - We will ensure you have quality healthcare coverage and opportunities to further your education.

record.Gecko Job Description:
Influ2 brings ABM to the contact level. With Influ2, you can act on contact-level intent, reach specific buyers with ads, orchestrate journeys across channels, and make the revenue impact clear.

200+ enterprises and mid-market companies worldwide, including industry leaders such as Snowflake, AppsFlyer, and Capgemini, love our technology. We hope you will love it too.

Who we are looking for:

We're looking for a Content Marketing Manager who knows the difference between content that's worth someone's time and content that just fills a page.

A content creator with a perspective that goes beyond what AI can generate, strong writing skills, a feel for what resonates with people, and a sharp editorial instinct.

You'll own Influ2's content strategy and execution across channels, from website and blog content to thought leadership and email marketing.

You'll work closely with every marketing function, especially SEO, to make sure our content is both genuinely good and effective.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys shaping the direction and doing the work.

- Content strategy: Own our content strategy and editorial calendar. Identify the topics, stories, and formats worth investing in, and connect content priorities to our goals.

- Content creation: Write, edit, and produce content across our website, blog, thought leadership, customer stories, reports, and other formats.

- SEO and GEO growth: Partner closely with SEO to create content that earns visibility without sacrificing quality.

- Email marketing content: Own the content and copy for email marketing, including newsletter, nurture sequences, campaign emails, and customer comms.

- Content distribution: Work with channel owners to find opportunities to extend the life and impact of strong content.

- Editorial quality: Set and maintain a high editorial standard across everything we publish, making sure our content is clear, distinctive, and worth someone's attention.

 

What success looks like: Influ2 produces content that people recognize, remember, and want to engage with, and that impact shows up in the pipeline. Marketing teams see you as a creative and strategic partner who brings strong ideas.

- 5+ years of experience in content marketing or editorial roles, preferably within B2B technology or SaaS. Experience in martech, adtech, or ABM is a strong plus.

- A strong portfolio of content you've personally written that shows original thinking, excellent writing, and the ability to work across formats.

- Experience owning content strategy and execution, from developing ideas to production and performance analysis that informs editorial and strategic decisions.

- You have strong editorial instincts. You can recognize a great idea, spot a boring one, and explain what would make it better.

- You're an excellent writer and editor. You can make complicated topics feel simple without stripping away what makes them valuable.

- You have a point of view. You follow what's happening in marketing and technology, question familiar approaches, and come up with ideas that aren't obvious.

- You're curious about customers, their challenges, and how they make decisions. You know how to find useful insights through conversations, research, and data.

- You can move between big-picture thinking and hands-on execution.

 

At Influ2, we highly appreciate a wide range of experiences and backgrounds. So, even if your history doesn't perfectly match our list, we would still be delighted to receive your application and learn more about you!

- Have a direct impact on how Influ2 tells its story and builds its voice in the market.

- Own content across the business, with room to experiment, introduce new formats, and bring your own ideas to life.

- Remote work flexibility with no fixed working hours; work where and when it suits you.

- Unlimited vacation policy to support a healthy work-life balance.

- Generous parental leave and other well-structured PTO policies.

- A well-rounded health package with comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.

 

We’ve raised a total of $15 million in our Series A round, maintaining a cash-positive business for the past 24 months while achieving 50% growth.

 

We're convinced that the diverse ideas and experiences every Influ2encer brings are the key to our success. To make sure our culture and products reflect this blend of viewpoints and backgrounds, there's no room for discrimination here. Our approach to hiring, training, promoting, and compensating individuals is grounded in merit and competence.

 

We're committed to offering equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, no matter their race, age, religion, where they come from, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Everyone at Influ2 plays a part in keeping our workplace welcoming and free from discrimination and harassment.

record.Gecko Job Description:
KPA has spent over four decades earning a reputation as the company automotive businesses trust with compliance. More than 15,000 of them count on us to protect their people, their customers, and their operations across Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), Sales, Advertising, Privacy, and HR.
Underneath it is one conviction: that documented is not the same as safe. A binder of current paperwork has never prevented an injury, so we built the company to close that gap. Software that's always watching out, training that reaches the newest person on the floor, and 150 consultants who keep finding what actually goes wrong. We think that work is worth doing somewhere people want to be, and Built In Colorado has named KPA one of the state's Best Places to Work seven years running.

Why This Role Exists
That kind of trust is a rare foundation for a marketing team, and it is the raw material for one of the best demand engines in B2B. Dealer groups are consolidating, and buyers increasingly start their research inside AI answer engines rather than a list of search results. Both shifts favor the company that builds for them first.
This role builds that engine: automation that meets buyers where they are, campaigns that run as one program rather than five, measurement clear enough that every dollar has an answer, and AI woven throughout it so a small team moves like a much larger one. You'd own it end to end, the automation, the campaigns, the data, and the pipeline outcomes, on top of a story nobody else in our industry can tell.
This is a builder's job at a company worth building for: if you'd rather design the whole engine than tune someone else's single channel, this is it.
The Role
The Manager, Demand Generation drives the execution and performance of KPA's demand programs across all paid, owned, and automated channels, and is a critical partner in improving the systems and measurement that underlie them. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with budget decision-making authority and a direct line to pipeline.
You'll spend your weeks in HubSpot, ZoomInfo, GA4, Salesforce, in the ad platforms and analytics, and in the space between marketing and revenue operations where demand engines drive results. You'll also use AI the way a team twice this size would use headcount, to research, produce, test, and operate, and to build workflows the rest of marketing can use too.
Success is measured in qualified pipeline that Sales agrees is qualified, a funnel everyone can see, and a cost per opportunity that improves quarter over quarter, with a clear decision and data behind each improvement you make.
What You'll Do
Own Omnichannel Demand Execution
Plan, build, launch, and optimize integrated campaigns across paid search, paid social, display and retargeting, email, content syndication, trade media, and webinars, with consistent measurement.

record.Gecko Job Description:
Lone Wolf empowers real estate customers to succeed and grow. As we deepen relationships with our highest-value accounts, we're seeking a strategic Account Based Marketing function to turn account insight into targeted, revenue-driving campaigns—and we need a leader to own it.
We're looking for a strategic, self-directed marketer who designs and executes targeted, data-driven campaigns for our highest-value accounts. You'll work in close alignment with sales teams, but you own the strategy.
This means evaluating and prioritizing accounts with sales, determining what success looks like, and building the measurement framework to track it. You'll collaborate closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Marketing Operations, while leading the strategic direction of account-based marketing initiatives.

 

### Account-Based Marketing Strategy

- Partner with Sales to evaluate target accounts and develop account selection criteria.

- Define the strategic rationale for account prioritization and segmentation.

- Determine which accounts represent the greatest opportunity and why.

- Develop go-to-market strategies tailored to target account segments.

- Use account, market, and performance data to continuously refine targeting strategies.

- Deliver account recommendations and insights that help Sales improve account prioritization over time.

### Account-Based Campaign Development & Execution

- Design and execute multi-channel ABM programs, including:

- Email marketing

- Digital advertising

- Direct mail campaigns

- Events and webinars

- Content marketing initiatives

- Create account-specific messaging and campaign strategies.

- Partner with Content, Design, and Marketing Operations teams to bring campaigns to life.

- Ensure campaigns align to revenue goals and account engagement objectives.

### Sales Partnership & Strategic Planning

- Collaborate with Sales teams to understand account priorities and opportunities.

- Evaluate whether ABM is the most effective approach for target accounts.

- Challenge assumptions and validate account strategies using market intelligence and data.

- Provide strategic guidance on account engagement and expansion opportunities.

- Act as a trusted advisor to Sales while maintaining an objective, data-driven perspective.

### Measurement & Performance Strategy

- Define campaign success metrics and measurement frameworks.

- Partner with Marketing Operations to establish reporting for:

- Campaign performance

- Account engagement

- Pipeline influence

- Revenue impact

- Analyze results and translate insights into actionable recommendations.

- Use performance data to optimize future campaign strategy and investment decisions.

### Personalization & Optimization

- Leverage account, customer, and intent data to build personalized experiences.

- Segment audiences to improve campaign relevance and effectiveness.

- Monitor campaign outcomes and identify drivers of success or underperformance.

- Continuously test, learn, and optimize campaign approaches based on performance insights.

### Account Advocacy

- Serve as the voice of target accounts within the marketing organization.

- Share market and account insights with Product Marketing, Sales, and leadership.

- Help influence broader marketing, messaging, and product strategies based on customer needs and feedback.

- 5-7 years of B2B marketing experience.

- Proven experience building, managing, and optimizing:

- Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs

- Field marketing initiatives

- Revenue-focused campaign strategies

- Experience partnering directly with Sales organizations on strategic account planning.

- Demonstrated ability to make data-driven marketing decisions and influence business outcomes.

- Strong strategic thinking and ability to operate independently.

- Experience developing multi-channel marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to:

- Interpret performance data

- Identify trends and opportunities

- Make strategic recommendations

- Excellent project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

### Preferred

- Experience in:

- B2B SaaS organizations

- Real estate technology (PropTech)

- Real estate-related industries

- Experience with:

- HubSpot

- Salesforce

- Marketing automation platforms

- CRM systems

- Familiarity with account intent platforms and ABM technologies.

### Strategic Independence

- Self-directed and highly accountable.

- Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

- Challenges assumptions and validates ideas through data.

- Focuses on business outcomes, not just campaign execution.

### Data-Driven Decision Making

- Understands the difference between engagement metrics and business impact metrics.

- Uses data to guide strategy development and optimization.

- Asks thoughtful questions and translates insights into action.

### Cross-Functional Partnership

- Builds strong relationships across Sales, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Sales Enablement.

- Influences stakeholders without direct authority.

- Balances collaboration with strategic conviction.

### Critical Thinking

- Takes a first-principles approach to problem solving.

- Evaluates strategies based on account needs and business objectives rather than industry "best practices."

- Maintains intellectual curiosity and adaptability in a changing market.

# Paid Social Media Buyer — Meta Lead Gen & Creative Strategy

Remote · Contractor · Long-term opportunity

## Read this before applying.

NEW ERA Digital Marketing helps painting contractors across the U.S. and Canada grow through paid advertising.

We do not work with every industry.

We work with painting companies.

That means our campaigns need to do more than generate cheap leads.

They need to generate real homeowner interest, booked estimates, and results our clients can feel in their business.

That is why we are hiring a Paid Social Media Buyer — Meta Lead Gen & Creative Strategy.

This role is for someone who can help manage Facebook and Instagram lead-generation campaigns, improve campaign performance, think through creative angles, protect lead quality, and communicate clearly with the team.

This is not just a “boost posts and check CPL” role.

You need to understand campaign setup, lead forms, creative testing, optimization, reporting, and what happens after a lead comes in.

## The Mission

Help NEW ERA deliver better campaign results for painting contractors.

That means:

- 

Leads are being generated.

- 

Lead quality is being watched.

- 

Campaigns are being reviewed consistently.

- 

Creative angles are being tested.

- 

Client feedback is being used.

- 

Changes are being documented.

- 

Updates are clear.

Issues are escalated before they become bigger problems.

Your job is to help make the paid ads side of the business cleaner, sharper, and more reliable.

## What You Will Own

You will help with:

- 

Creating, launching, and managing Meta ad campaigns

- 

Setting up Facebook lead forms

- 

Reviewing campaign performance

- 

Optimizing ads based on data, lead quality, and client feedback

- 

Testing new ad creatives, hooks, angles, and copy

- 

Reviewing CTR, link CTR, CPM, CPL, booked appointments, and lead quality

- 

Helping identify why campaigns are underperforming

- 

Documenting campaign changes and test results

- 

Sending or preparing weekly/biweekly Loom updates

- 

Communicating campaign issues, ideas, and next actions clearly

- 

Working with the creative team to request or improve ad assets

- 

Helping maintain campaign logs, reports, and optimization notes

The internal role package for this position already includes campaign setup, lead-form QA, routing/tracking checks, launch QA, optimization cadence, lead-quality troubleshooting, creative angle iteration, AI-assisted creative workflow, campaign logs, Loom updates, and escalation expectations.

## What Good Media Buying Looks Like Here

Good media buying at NEW ERA is not just low CPL.

A campaign with cheap leads but poor booked appointments is not a win.

A campaign with higher CPL but better estimate quality may be more valuable.

You need to think beyond surface-level metrics.

We care about:

- 

ROAS

- 

CPA

- 

Cost per booked estimate

- 

ABR %

- 

CPL

- 

Lead quality

- 

No-shows

- 

Spam or bad-fit leads

- 

Client feedback

- 

Creative fatigue

- 

Downstream business results where available

Your job is to help us understand what is actually happening, not just what the ad dashboard says.

## What Success Looks Like

### First 30 Days

You understand our clients, offer, campaign structure, SOPs, and quality standards.

You can review accounts, identify obvious issues, help with campaign QA, and document what you’re seeing.

You complete supervised campaign setup or optimization work.

You send a practice Loom or written update for review.

### First 60 Days

Who We Are

At Pave, we're building the industry’s leading compensation platform, combining the world's largest real-time compensation dataset with deep expertise in AI and machine learning. Our platform is perfecting the art and science of pay to give 9,000+ companies unparalleled confidence in every compensation decision.

Top tier companies like OpenAI, McDonald’s, Instacart, Atlassian, Affirm, Ericsson, Synopsys, Stripe, Doordash, Fanatics, Databricks, and Waymo use Pave, transforming every pay decision into a competitive advantage. $190+ billion in total compensation spend is managed in our workflows, and 80% of Forbes AI 50 use Pave to benchmark compensation.

The future of pay is real-time & predictive, and we’re making it happen right now. We’ve raised $175M in funding from leading investors like Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Insight Partners, Atomico, Venture Partners, and Craft Ventures.

The Marketing Team @ Pave

Marketing at Pave builds the brand energy and demand that fuel the business. We take our real-time compensation data and turn it into campaigns, stories, and market-moving moments that earn attention, create pipeline, and make Pave the first name people think of in compensation.

We work shoulder to shoulder across the business, but primarily with revenue and product teams, to ensure we are supporting what’s built and what’s sold.  We sharpen positioning, launch products with impact, and give sellers content that opens doors and helps close deals. We're accountable for results: qualified leads, revenue influence, and a brand people seek out.

We move fast, test boldly, and let the data tell us what's working so we can double down. We celebrate every win together, and we believe great marketing should be as fun to make as it is to read.

What You'll Do

  • Leadership: You will be a critical member of the marketing team and a strong, trusted voice across the business. You will have a track record of influencing and activating work streams within marketing and beyond
  • Marketing communications: You will own Pave's external communications strategy and operating rhythm across our critical channels. You will be the point of contact for reactive communications, moving quickly on market moments while managing reputational risk. You will also prepare executives for media and speaking opportunities
  • Brand marketing: You will work with internal and external creative teams to make our brand world-class, unique, differentiated, and beloved. You will establish Pave as a known, trusted, and loved brand among all our stakeholders, including our internal teams, customers, prospects, and partners. You will ensure a consistent voice, a steady cadence, and measurable impact
  • Public relations: You will hire and engage the right PR resources to grow our earned media position. You will use the valuable data we have to activate stories that directly or indirectly strengthen Pave's position in the marketplace. You will track our reach and take steps to grow it. You will also mobilize internal resources to support these narratives
  • Thought leadership: Pave has access to critical data on one of the most important topics in the world: compensation. You will think creatively about how we shape our own points of view and bring them to market through internal, external, analyst, and media partners
  • Website: You will own the marketing website, including its roadmap and evolution. You will monitor its performance and take the steps needed to ensure it serves our customers and prospects
  • Customer stories: Shining a light on how customers get their jobs done with Pave is a critical part of our GTM. You will find and tell the stories that set Pave apart, from customer impact to product innovation to our point of view on the future of compensation. You will partner with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Marketing to turn them into stronger narratives
  • Development: You will lead and develop members of the marketing team. You will determine the right mix of in-house talent, agencies, and freelancers to scale high-quality output. Your thoughtful approach will help activate the talents and growth of everyone on the team
  • Measurement: You will define and track communications metrics, including share of voice and brand awareness. You will report on results and ROI to marketing leadership, and you will manage agency partnerships and the communications budget.
  • Budget management: You will own and manage a budget so that we are responsible with our spend and successful at creating impact

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years overall experience in Marketing, Demand Growth and or within a similar field
  • Proven experience in marketing communications, PR, or brand marketing, ideally at a B2B technology company, with a track record of owning external communications end to end. Please review the section titled “What you’ll bring” to understand the type of person who we are looking for 
  • Experience leading and developing a team, and managing agencies and freelancers across multiple projects at once
  • Strong storytelling and messaging skills, with experience developing content and thought leadership across the buyer journey and overseeing content development and approval processes
  • Experience with media relations, executive communications, and reputation or crisis communications
  • Fluency in marketing channel metrics and quantitative and qualitative research, with the ability to translate communications results into business value
  • Excellent project management, written and verbal communication, resourcefulness, and problem-solving skills, with a bias for action and accountability
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field preferred
  • Some of the intangibles that we’ll be looking for include a strong curiosity, a bias for action, an ability to solve problems, and a passion for working with the entire Pave team

Compensation, It's What We Do.

At Pave, we believe compensation should be as thoughtful as the people we hire. This role is structured as a B2B contract engagement — and your total rewards package includes meaningful equity, flexible PTO, and region-specific benefits designed around your life, not just your role. Your level and compensation are determined by your experience and how you show up throughout the interview process. We're always happy to walk you through how we think about leveling — just ask.

Targeted cash compensation for this role: 
$160,000-$170,000 Base + Equity

Benefits @ Pave

At Pave, growth isn't a perk — it's the point. As you develop, your role expands, your responsibilities deepen, and your compensation reflects the impact you're making.

What we offer

  • Your Health, Fully Covered: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with a range of options designed to meet you where you are.
  • Time That's Actually Yours: Flexible PTO and the freedom to work from anywhere in the world for up to a month — because life doesn't pause, and neither should you.
  • Fuel for the Work: Lunch and dinner stipends plus fully stocked kitchens, so you can stay energized without thinking twice about it.
  • Room to Keep Growing: A quarterly education stipend to invest in the skills and knowledge that matter most to you.
  • Support When It Matters Most: Robust parental leave so you can be fully present for the moments that count.
  • Getting Here, Made Easier: A commuter stipend to support the in-person collaboration that makes great work happen.

Life @ Pave 

Founded in 2019 with a clear purpose and a team that has never wavered from it, Pave has grown into a global force in compensation management — giving thousands of companies the tools to take control, build confidence, and earn credibility in every pay decision they make. And we're just getting started. Headquartered in San Francisco's Financial District, with regional hubs in New York City's Flatiron District, Salt Lake City, Kraków (Poland), and the United Kingdom — wherever you're based, you'll find the same thing: people who genuinely care about the work, each other, and the customers that rely on Pave.

We run a hybrid culture that brings teams together in person 4 days a week — and every Friday, the whole company gathers for our Team Sync: breakfast, new hire welcomes, product updates, fireside chats, and yes, the occasional Kahoot. It's one of the things people notice when they join us — that we truly enjoy spending time together.

Our culture is shaped by five values we live every day:

  • Be Intellectually Honest — Truth over comfort. We face reality clearly and speak directly, even when it's hard.
  • Play to Win — We're not here to participate. We're here to be the #1 compensation platform in the world, and we act like it.
  • Uphold the Pave Platinum Standard — We hold ourselves to the highest bar — for our customers, our data, and each other.
  • One Team — We win and lose together. Titles don't drive decisions here — shared goals do.
  • Hug of Jawn — Hard to define, impossible to miss. Ask your recruiter.

Our Vision: Unlock a labor market built on trust.

Our Mission: Build confidence in every compensation decision.

We build software that transforms how companies pay their people — and we believe the team behind that software deserves the same thoughtfulness. If you're ready to help shape the future of compensation alongside people who are smart, humble, and genuinely motivated by the problem we're solving, we'd love to meet you. 

Still deliberating? Just apply! We're always excited to meet people who are eager to contribute.

Pave uses automated tools, including AI-based fraud detection, to verify applicant identity and protect the integrity of our hiring process.

Founded in 2019 with a clear purpose and a team that has never wavered from it, Pave has grown into a global force in compensation management — giving thousands of companies the tools to take control, build confidence, and earn credibility in every pay decision they make. And we're just getting started. Headquartered in San Francisco's Financial District, with regional hubs in New York City's Flatiron District, Salt Lake City, Kraków (Poland), and the United Kingdom — wherever you're based, you'll find the same thing: people who genuinely care about the work, each other, and the customers that rely on Pave.

We run a hybrid culture that brings teams together in person 4 days a week — and every Friday, the whole company gathers for our Team Sync: breakfast, new hire welcomes, product updates, fireside chats, and yes, the occasional Kahoot. It's one of the things people notice when they join us — that we truly enjoy spending time together.

Our culture is shaped by five values we live every day:

  • Be Intellectually Honest — Truth over comfort. We face reality clearly and speak directly, even when it's hard.
  • Play to Win — We're not here to participate. We're here to be the #1 compensation platform in the world, and we act like it.
  • Uphold the Pave Platinum Standard — We hold ourselves to the highest bar — for our customers, our data, and each other.
  • One Team — We win and lose together. Titles don't drive decisions here — shared goals do.
  • Hug of Jawn — Hard to define, impossible to miss. Ask your recruiter.

Our Vision: Unlock a labor market built on trust.

Our Mission: Build confidence in every compensation decision.

We build software that transforms how companies pay their people — and we believe the team behind that software deserves the same thoughtfulness. If you're ready to help shape the future of compensation alongside people who are smart, humble, and genuinely motivated by the problem we're solving, we'd love to meet you. 

Still deliberating? Just apply! We're always excited to meet people who are eager to contribute.

Pave uses automated tools, including AI-based fraud detection, to verify applicant identity and protect the integrity of our hiring process.

record.Gecko Job Description:
About Origin

Origin is building the endpoint AI observability platform for AI-adopting organizations. We believe that organizations should not adopt AI on their endpoints without observability in place, and we want to be the platform that maximizes the productivity & safety of that adoption.

The company exists to maximize the diffusion of intelligence inside an organization, maximize the productivity of agentic systems and the humans driving them, keep agent actions traceable end-to-end so that when a user asks for something in a prompt they can verify the agent actually did what was expected, and give organizations one interface to answer the hardest questions they have about how work gets done.

Our platform monitors and protects some of the most important organizations in the world. We are backed by Sequoia Capital, Brightmind Ventures, IA Ventures and other top firms.

Role

Origin is seeking a Demand Generation Lead to build and execute programs that turn awareness into qualified pipeline and sustainable growth. This is a hands-on, strategic individual contributor role for someone who can both do the work and determine what excellence looks like.

You’ll own demand generation across paid search, LinkedIn, Reddit, and emerging channels, developing campaign strategy, launching and optimizing programs, analyzing performance, and identifying new opportunities to reach and engage our ideal customers.

AI is central to how this role operates. You’ll use AI to improve campaign execution, automate repetitive work, and build systems that make demand generation more efficient and scalable, freeing the team to focus on strategy and growth.

You’ll also explore opportunities across media, podcasts, content, and partnerships, bringing a strong understanding of our ideal customers and the cybersecurity market to create relevant, differentiated, and measurable campaigns.

This role offers meaningful ownership from day one. You’ll work autonomously within a team, bring a clear point of view, and help shape the demand generation function as Origin grows.

Responsibilities

- 

Develop and execute multi-channel demand generation strategies across paid search, LinkedIn, Reddit and emerging channels to drive qualified pipeline and growth

- 

Own campaigns end-to-end, from strategy and creative development through launch, testing, optimization and performance reporting

- 

Identify and test new opportunities across media, podcasts, content, partnerships and emerging channels to uncover scalable growth opportunities

- 

Analyze campaign performance and customer insights to improve acquisition efficiency and inform future strategy

- 

Partner with Sales, Product and Marketing to align demand programs with our ICP, buyer journey, messaging and go-to-market priorities

- 

Use AI to improve campaign development and execution, automate repeatable processes, and build scalable systems that make demand generation more efficient

Skills and Experience

- 

3+ years of experience in demand generation, performance marketing, growth marketing, or a related discipline

- 

Hands-on experience with paid acquisition, particularly Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads, with a strong understanding of campaign optimization and measurement

- 

Strong strategic and analytical judgment with the ability to connect marketing activity to pipeline and business outcomes

- 

Experience with marketing automation, CRM and marketing technology platforms such as HubSpot and Clay

- 

Demonstrated ability to use AI to improve the quality, speed and scalability of marketing work

- 

Highly autonomous, curious and comfortable working in a lean, fast-moving environment with a strong experimentation mindset

Nice to Haves

- 

Experience in cybersecurity or information security, ideally in B2B SaaS

- 

Experience marketing technical products to B2B audiences

- 

Experience with Reddit Ads, Webflow, CRO, SEO, or GEO

- 

Experience with Clay, AI-powered marketing workflows, or automation

- 

Experience with media, podcasts, partnerships or other emerging demand generation channels

Working at Origin

Origin is a fully remote team across the US & Canada, built on trust, autonomy, and excellence. We empower our team to take ownership, move with purpose, and continuously improve. Our culture values top performers who align with our mission and embrace high standards. We offer generous healthcare, flexible PTO, and home-office support, ensuring our team has the freedom and resources to thrive. While we move fast, we prioritize quality and collaboration, and we remain committed to building impactful security solutions with precision.
