record.Gecko Job Description:
Who we are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

## Why would you love this job?

Redis is the platform developers trust for real-time data—and the platform an increasing share of AI applications are built on. Now, the audience discovering and evaluating Redis is no longer exclusively human. AI agents can identify a need, decide which solution fits, review technical documentation, and create a new account within one continuous session.

The Lead, Growth Marketing owns the Redis digital surface for both agents and humans. This includes the website, SEO, answer engine optimization, generative engine optimization, conversion-rate optimization, and the measurement system that connects discovery to pipeline, account creation, and activation.

Your central challenge is to streamline agent-led growth: making Redis easy for agents to discover, understand, recommend, evaluate, and select while ensuring the same digital experience converts human developers and buyers.

This is a hands-on strategic leadership role for a builder who wants to create a new kind of digital growth system at a high-growth, pre-IPO company. You’ll define the strategy, direct external specialists, contribute to the highest-priority work, measure the outcomes, and continuously improve the system with data.

You should be as comfortable presenting a strategy to executives as you are opening an AI tool and building a working campaign prototype from a blank page in 30 minutes.

## What you’ll do

- 

Own the Redis digital surface. Set the strategy for how agents and humans discover, understand, evaluate, and convert across Redis’s website, documentation pathways, organic presence, and AI surfaces.

- 

Lead agent-driven growth. Build a low-friction journey in which an agent can identify the right Redis solution, review the relevant documentation, and create an account in a single session.

- 

Own SEO, AEO, and GEO. Establish the strategy for search engines, AI answer engines, generative search, assistants, and coding agents so Redis is accurately represented, cited, recommended, and selected.

- 

Own website strategy. Define the platform story, information architecture, page priorities, content pathways, and contextual-conversion model. Partner with web engineering on implementation and feasibility.

- 

Lead CRO and experimentation. Maintain a rigorous testing roadmap across high-intent pages, documentation journeys, sign-up flows, and other critical conversion points.

- 

Build the measurement system. Connect human and agent discovery to meaningful outcomes, including visibility, citations, recommendations, documentation engagement, account creation, conversion, activation, and pipeline.

- 

Turn data into action. Use performance data to improve the strategy, prioritize the roadmap, reallocate resources, and decide what to scale, revise, or stop.

- 

Direct external specialists. Set priorities and scopes of work for contractors and an agency partner, review output, and redirect capacity as business needs change.

- 

Align the digital growth engine. Partner with content, developer relations, product, engineering, paid media, and executive leadership so Redis presents one connected path from discovery to adoption.

## What you’ll need to have

- 

Typically 7+ years in digital growth or GTM marketing, including meaningful experience inside high-growth B2B SaaS, infrastructure, or AI-adjacent companies.

- 

A record of building or materially improving digital growth systems where the strategy and operating model were not already fully defined.

- 

Deep experience owning website strategy, digital conversion, and organic growth—not simply supporting those functions.

- 

Experience developing integrated SEO, AEO, or GEO strategies across traditional search, generative search, AI assistants, answer engines, or coding agents.

- 

An understanding of how content, documentation, citations, authority, structured information, and technical foundations influence AI recommendations and technology selection.

- 

Experience defining measurement for emerging digital journeys, including the ability to connect leading signals to account creation, activation, pipeline, or revenue.

- 

Direct ownership of a CRO and experimentation program, with strong analytical and statistical judgment.

- 

Experience defining email and GTM-orchestration strategy while directing specialists who handle implementation and ongoing operations.

- 

Demonstrated use of AI tools and agents to research, plan, build, analyze, or optimize marketing programs.

- 

AI-native operating fluency: you can rapidly turn a business objective into a credible campaign, journey, or workflow prototype and then improve it with judgment and data.

- 

Experience directing contractors and agency-staffed specialists, including scoping work, setting priorities, reviewing output, and reallocating capacity.

- 

Strong executive communication and the willingness to move between strategy and hands-on work.

We give back to our employees:

Our culture is what makes Redis a fun and rewarding place to work. To support you at work and beyond, we offer all our US team members fantastic benefits and perks:

- 

Competitive salaries and equity grants

- 

Unlimited time off to promote a healthy work-life balance

- 

H/D/V coverage along with 401K, FSA, and commuter benefits

- 

Frequent team celebrations and recreation events

- 

Home internet & phone stipend

- 

Learning and development opportunities

- 

Ability to influence a high-performance company on its way to IPO

The estimated gross base annual salary range for this role is $170,000 - $210,000 per year in New York, California, Washington, Colorado, and Rhode Island. Actual compensation may vary and is dependent on various factors, including a candidate’s work location, qualifications, experience, and competencies. Base annual salary is one component of Redis’ total compensation and competitive benefits package, which may include 401(k), unlimited time off, learning and development opportunities, and comprehensive health and wellness benefits. This role may include discretionary bonuses, stock options, commuter benefits based on location, or a commission plan. Salary history is not used in compensation package decisions. Redis utilizes market pay data to determine compensation, so posted compensation ranges are subject to change as new market data becomes available.

#LI-AB1

 

As a global company, we value a culture of curiosity, diversity of thought, and innovation from our employees, customers, and partners. Redis is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment where all employees’ differences are celebrated and supported, and everyone feels safe to bring their authentic selves to work. Redis is dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, Veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard, and every idea is respected.

Redis is committed to working with and providing access and reasonable accommodation to applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require accommodations for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to recruiting@redis.com. All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

Any offer of employment at Redis is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable laws.

Redis reserves the right to retain data longer than stated in the privacy policy in order to evaluate candidates.

record.Gecko Job Description:
What do we do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern commmerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it hurts your bottom line.


We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the only AI harness in commerce — Moby — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.


The result: more than 65,000 brands like Kitsch, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

About the role

Triple Whale is looking for a creative product marketer to own our go-to-market launches and support product marketing for our platform team.

You’ll combine a content creator’s instincts with a launch manager’s organization to lead weekly drops and larger monthly launches. Inspired by how consumer brands build anticipation, you’ll create content across formats that gets people to notice, share, and try our products. You’ll bring an AI-first mindset to move quickly from idea to execution.

Our platform team focuses on the technology that makes Triple Whale exceptional, including data, infrastructure, and UI components. You’ll translate that work into clear positioning, messaging, and customer communications that explain what’s changing, why it matters, and how customers benefit.

What you’ll own

Go-to-market launches and weekly drops

  • Own the launch calendar and execution. Coordinate weekly drops and monthly launches with clear timelines, owners, and deliverables. Keep teams aligned on product readiness and messaging while reducing coordination work for other product marketers.
  • Build a recognizable weekly drop program. Develop its creative approach and keep formats fresh. Feature new capabilities, useful improvements, and existing features customers have yet to discover.
  • Shape the story and create the content. Partner with product marketers on the audience, customer benefit, and desired action. Write copy, record demos, and produce videos, carousels, or simple visual assets without requiring a full production cycle.
  • Make social and creators central to launches. Collaborate on product reveals, walkthroughs, and other formats worth sharing. Match the format to the story; weekly drops do not require a blog post.
  • Coordinate the customer experience. Work with Growth, Lifecycle, and other channel owners to align social, email, in-app messages, and supporting launch activity.
  • Measure and improve. Define success for each launch, from reach and engagement to activation and adoption. Use focused debriefs and audience feedback to improve the next drop.

Platform product marketing

  • Lead product marketing for the platform team. Partner with Product on the roadmap, prioritize marketing support, and translate technical or behind-the-scenes improvements into clear customer value.
  • Own positioning and messaging. Explain what changes, who benefits, and why it matters. Develop stories that connect platform capabilities to customer needs.
  • Bring customer and market insights into product decisions. Conduct research, gather feedback from Sales and Customer Success, and assess competing approaches to inform the roadmap and messaging.
  • Support customer understanding and adoption. Partner with Lifecycle and Customer Success on communications and education. Equip customer-facing teams with demos, talk tracks, and FAQs, then track adoption and feedback with Product.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, launch marketing, integrated campaigns, or a related role. We welcome backgrounds in B2B SaaS, consumer software, and D2C or e-commerce brands.
  • Experience taking launches from idea through execution, with a clear understanding of what drove results and what you would improve.
  • Strong creative instincts and confidence creating content yourself across formats, including written copy, short-form video, product demos, and visual storytelling.
  • An AI-first mindset. You actively use AI for research, ideation, content production, and repeatable workflows, while applying your own judgment to accuracy and quality.
  • Product marketing fundamentals, including customer research, positioning, and translating features into benefits. You’re comfortable learning software and demonstrating it through recorded or on-camera content.
  • Strong project management and collaboration skills. You can manage overlapping timelines, resolve blockers, and drive accountability without adding unnecessary process.
  • Good judgment about scope and measurement. You know when a release needs a larger campaign, when a well-made video is enough, and how to distinguish attention from adoption.

Especially relevant experience

  • Building recurring content series, product drops, or creator collaborations that give audiences a reason to return.
  • Marketing to e-commerce operators or working within the tools and communities they use.

What success looks like

Triple Whale has a consistent launch rhythm, with creative weekly drops and well-coordinated monthly launches. Product marketers spend less time chasing deliverables. Customers understand platform changes and how to use them, and launch results inform what we do next.

The expected base salary for this role is $115,000–$125,000 per year. 

Eligible employees receive medical coverage; a 401(k) with a company match of up to 3%; 30 days of paid time off accrued monthly after the first 30 days of employment; five sick days; and nine paid company holidays. Triple Whale also offers paid parental leave for eligible employees.

Join Us in Making Waves

If you’re looking for more than just a job and want to be part of a movement reshaping the future of Ecommerce, Triple Whale is the place for you. We’re on the lookout for driven, curious, and creative individuals ready to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Referred?  Got here thanks to a friend? Splash some gratitude their way!  They'll need to submit your application through our referral system to make it official.

Our platform team focuses on the technology that makes Triple Whale exceptional, including data, infrastructure, and UI components. You’ll translate that work into clear positioning, messaging, and customer communications that explain what’s changing, why it matters, and how customers benefit.

What you’ll own

Go-to-market launches and weekly drops

  • Own the launch calendar and execution. Coordinate weekly drops and monthly launches with clear timelines, owners, and deliverables. Keep teams aligned on product readiness and messaging while reducing coordination work for other product marketers.
  • Build a recognizable weekly drop program. Develop its creative approach and keep formats fresh. Feature new capabilities, useful improvements, and existing features customers have yet to discover.
  • Shape the story and create the content. Partner with product marketers on the audience, customer benefit, and desired action. Write copy, record demos, and produce videos, carousels, or simple visual assets without requiring a full production cycle.
  • Make social and creators central to launches. Collaborate on product reveals, walkthroughs, and other formats worth sharing. Match the format to the story; weekly drops do not require a blog post.
  • Coordinate the customer experience. Work with Growth, Lifecycle, and other channel owners to align social, email, in-app messages, and supporting launch activity.
  • Measure and improve. Define success for each launch, from reach and engagement to activation and adoption. Use focused debriefs and audience feedback to improve the next drop.

Platform product marketing

  • Lead product marketing for the platform team. Partner with Product on the roadmap, prioritize marketing support, and translate technical or behind-the-scenes improvements into clear customer value.
  • Own positioning and messaging. Explain what changes, who benefits, and why it matters. Develop stories that connect platform capabilities to customer needs.
  • Bring customer and market insights into product decisions. Conduct research, gather feedback from Sales and Customer Success, and assess competing approaches to inform the roadmap and messaging.
  • Support customer understanding and adoption. Partner with Lifecycle and Customer Success on communications and education. Equip customer-facing teams with demos, talk tracks, and FAQs, then track adoption and feedback with Product.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing, launch marketing, integrated campaigns, or a related role. We welcome backgrounds in B2B SaaS, consumer software, and D2C or e-commerce brands.
  • Experience taking launches from idea through execution, with a clear understanding of what drove results and what you would improve.
  • Strong creative instincts and confidence creating content yourself across formats, including written copy, short-form video, product demos, and visual storytelling.
  • An AI-first mindset. You actively use AI for research, ideation, content production, and repeatable workflows, while applying your own judgment to accuracy and quality.
  • Product marketing fundamentals, including customer research, positioning, and translating features into benefits. You’re comfortable learning software and demonstrating it through recorded or on-camera content.
  • Strong project management and collaboration skills. You can manage overlapping timelines, resolve blockers, and drive accountability without adding unnecessary process.
  • Good judgment about scope and measurement. You know when a release needs a larger campaign, when a well-made video is enough, and how to distinguish attention from adoption.

Especially relevant experience

  • Building recurring content series, product drops, or creator collaborations that give audiences a reason to return.
  • Marketing to e-commerce operators or working within the tools and communities they use.

What success looks like

Triple Whale has a consistent launch rhythm, with creative weekly drops and well-coordinated monthly launches. Product marketers spend less time chasing deliverables. Customers understand platform changes and how to use them, and launch results inform what we do next.

The expected base salary for this role is $115,000–$125,000 per year. 

Eligible employees receive medical coverage; a 401(k) with a company match of up to 3%; 30 days of paid time off accrued monthly after the first 30 days of employment; five sick days; and nine paid company holidays. Triple Whale also offers paid parental leave for eligible employees.

Join Us in Making Waves

If you’re looking for more than just a job and want to be part of a movement reshaping the future of Ecommerce, Triple Whale is the place for you. We’re on the lookout for driven, curious, and creative individuals ready to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Referred?  Got here thanks to a friend? Splash some gratitude their way!  They'll need to submit your application through our referral system to make it official.

Company Overview:
At Wayvia, we help the world’s top brands stay ahead—using AI, data, and innovation to shape the future of commerce. Whether you’re charting a new path or leveling up your journey, Wayvia is where your career can go further. We’d love to meet you.
 
We help global brands connect with their shoppers in ways that are relevant, respectful, and real. And we do the same for each other—with trust, transparency, and the human connection that makes great work possible.
 
At Wayvia, you’ll find a team that’s curious, collaborative, and always up for solving what’s next. We move fast, think boldly, and support one another in building something that matters—for our clients, for shoppers, and for each other. 

 

Job Brief 

The Head of Marketing will own the marketing function at Wayvia, including demand generation, market positioning, product marketing, brand and communications, agency partnerships and budget management. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and leading a team, this role will be accountable for marketing-sourced pipeline, strategy, programs and execution.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities 

  • Demand Generation and Pipeline — Own the programs that produce marketing-sourced pipeline. 
  • Market and Positioning Strategy — Form and defend a view of how the market is changing — buying behavior, pricing models, category definition — and get the business to act on it, working closely with Sales leadership. 
  • Product Marketing — Own positioning, launch and enablement across the product line, working as a counterpart to Product.
  • Brand, Communications and Agencies — Own the brand, core messaging and all marketing communications, including the agency and PR relationships.
  • Team Leadership — Lead and develop a team across product marketing, growth, brand and marketing operations.
  • AI-Enabled Operating Model — Build marketing as a system, with AI agents doing real work in strategy, campaign execution and iteration.
  • Customer Community — Stand up a marketing-led customer community — user groups and focus groups — that produces product input and references.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 6+ years in a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment. 
  • Demonstrated ownership of demand generation.
  • People management of a multi-function marketing team. 
  • Fluency with AI as an operating capability.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Product marketing depth across launch and enablement. 
  • Commerce intelligence, retail media, martech or adtech experience. 
  • Institutional investor and board-level presentation experience. 
  • A category creation or thought-leadership track record. 
  • MBA or advanced degree. 

Wayvia is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity.

record.Gecko Job Description:
Reports to: CEO

Do you geek out on Media Buying, Creatives, Building Sales Funnels and love driving revenue through direct response marketing?  

Would you consider yourself a LEADER of people?  

If you’ve built and guided multiple teams, if you have at least 3+ years of experience with Media Buying, Sales Funnel Building, writing world class copy and want to trailblaze and lead a full pod of performance marketers - keep reading. 

As our Growth Marketing Manager, you’ll be the CEO of a highly skilled team of digital marketers and the CMO for CA clients, operating from a strong basis of industry knowledge and relational confidence. The Growth Marketing Manager acts as the catalyst for growth of our clients’ businesses. You are excited about the complexities of a business and love identifying solutions to growth problems. Both your team and your clients will look to you to point them in the right direction.

This is a position where you’ll work directly with the CEO on strategizing new sales funnels, writing copy, media buying, and driving ROAS.

Here are all the positions you will need to strategize with, build, lead and grow:

- Media Buyers

- Copywriters

- Videographers

- Business Intelligence

- Account Managers

RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership - Hiring & Leading Others (Must Have)
This is an absolute must in this position. You need to have hired and built multiple teams. Considering that you will oversee many different roles of our performance marketing, we expect you to develop our current leaders, delegate to them and lead their growth. You will be ultimately accountable for the KPIs and goals of the pod you will be overseeing. 

Funnel Strategy & Execution
You will help strategize, develop, & launch new marketing funnels for our top clients (Low Ticket Straight Sale Funnels, Webinar Funnels, Call Funnels, etc..)

You will work with the project manager in the pod to disseminate work to the various members in the pod, in order to fully launch the funnel in our timeline.

Forecasting HR
Assist in forecasting hiring needs for your pod. The GMM is responsible for collaborating with our HR dept. to ensure we are placing appropriate talent in each open role in our performance division, as well as onboarding, and training new Media Buyers properly.

Client Strategy & Quarterly Objectives
We are obsessed with client results, that’s why we need to make sure we’re constantly improving clients metrics. We want to implement monthly/quarterly/annual marketing metric reviews, including but not limited to analysis of campaign performance, lead conversion, customer database growth/quality and pipeline growth

Data-Driven Decision Making
In this company, our entire team is data-driven, we do not make decisions without data to support them. You will monitor key performance indicators of success for your pod, and make adjustments based upon targets.

Creative Ideation & Management

You will work with our copywriters & senior media buyers to ideate & launch hard hitting direct response video ads that drive ROAS.

Media Buying Strategy

You will work with the Senior Media Buyer in the pod to strategize the media buying for every client in the pod on a quarterly, monthly, and annual basis.

RESULTS

These are the results you will be responsible for delivering in this position.

-  Hit 95% of Projected Quarterly Bonus For Your Pod

- Own forecasting the quarterly bonus for all of the clients in the pod

- Track and report on the pacing of the bonus weekly

-  Achieve 90% of Client’s Growth KPIs

- Own forecasting profit, ROAS, booked calls, & overall spend for current & new clients

- Collaborate with media buyers to strategize and execute growth campaigns for clients.

- Drive initiatives to test new channels and diversify ad spend.

- Ensure timely and efficient optimization based on performance data.

-  Ensure Pod Maintains 65% Gross Profit Margin

- Pod must maintain 2x payroll before the bonus

- Ensure all time tracking sheets are submitted by Project Manager weekly

- GMM is the hiring manager for the pod and must make sure the pod has adequate resources to run successfully

-  Fully Build Out 1 New Sales Funnel Per Quarter

- Work with team to build out a full funnel for either 1 new client or existing client

- Develop overall strategy, big idea, products, and pricing strategy for funnel

- Ensure all marketing tech is setup correctly and sequences are all built out for the different stages of contacts lifecycle

- Measure and analyze the performance, refining strategies based on outcomes.

Requirements

- Minimum 3 years of experience working in the info product / consulting niche

- A proven track record for scaling consulting / information businesses.

- Experience managing advertising budgets on social media platforms in excess of $50,000 per month.

- Experience with email marketing preferred.

- Experience managing Google/YouTube advertising budgets preferred.

- Minimum 1-year experience managing a team or leading cross-functional projects.

- Agency experience and/or experience in a client-facing role preferred.

- Bachelor's Degree or similar experience preferred, but not necessary.

- Experience developing a holistic digital growth strategy through a deep understanding of organic and paid revenue sources.

COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS

We use Slack for Client & Internal Communications

We value over-communication (more context the better)

We value speed in communication (be prompt in responding or provide context as to why you may be slow to respond)

Weekly Full Team Meetings

Daily Stand Ups with Pods

WHO ARE WE?

Client Accelerators is the 'go to' company for coaches, consultants, experts, & authors who want to achieve sustained growth through paid acquisition channels like YouTube, Facebook, TikTok & Google. 

We were the 207th fastest growing company on the Inc 5000 list last year, and have had record growth for an advertising agency, growing an incredible 2,574% over the past 3 years.

We’ve been able to have this record growth because of the incredible results we’ve been able to get for our clients, which has allowed us to speak on stages all over the world on our strategies & tactics to doubling, tripling or even 10x their profits by working with us.

We take a hands-on approach to growing each client we bring in by scripting all of their creatives, video production, tracking, & running their ads on these channels to hit agreed upon targets. 

Our proven approach has allowed us to spend over $150 Million Dollars & generate over $300 Million Dollars in verified sales in the past 5 years. Currently, our company is focused on founder-led businesses across the e-learning, SaaS and service-based internet space.

We believe great people are at the center of every successful business. Employees are provided a full suite of benefits, including competitive compensation, healthcare, unlimited paid time off, and a fully remote working environment. (We also have offices in New Jersey & Florida if you’d prefer to work in-person 😃).

What makes Client Accelerators so different? For one, our founder, Mike Buontempo is a consultant himself, who has been consulting with different companies & entrepreneurs for the past 13 years. 

Our vision is to attract and hire the very best people to help our clients grow profitably and systematically through paid media. 

Client Accelerators Core Values

- We are problem solvers: If you spot a problem in our company or a client’s company, provide a solution. There’s millions of problems, and not as many problem solvers, be the solution.

- Open Source Code: We share what’s working with everyone

- Empty The Bucket: Picture this, if you just spent two hours cleaning your car, you put all of the cleaning materials away, but you notice you missed a spot. What do you do? You go back, get everything back out, and complete the job to perfection

- We’re a ‘TEAM’ not a Family: Leaders at CA hire, develop, and cut smartly, so we have Superstars at every position

- Ownership Thinking: Going out of your way to make sure your actions and the actions of your peers are in the best interest of the company

- Being The Best: Mastering your domain so you’re the best in the world at it

Benefits

MEDICAL | Full health, dental, and vision benefits (W2 Employees)

Great career growth opportunity - You’ll be working with ‘A’ players in Operations, Sales, Creative, and Media Buying

Company Leadership Events and Industry Conferences

record.Gecko Job Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager based in the United States.

As Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you will own the end-to-end growth strategy for a veterinary staffing marketplace, helping independent animal hospitals discover, adopt, and consistently use innovative staffing solutions. You will lead acquisition, activation, retention, and reactivation initiatives, with success measured by meaningful business outcomes rather than sign-ups alone. As the first dedicated growth marketer for the hospital business, you will build the growth engine from the ground up, shaping channel strategy, budget allocation, experimentation, and performance measurement. Working closely with Sales, Product, Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing, and Brand teams, you will turn customer insights into scalable growth programs. You will optimize the hospital journey from initial awareness to the first successfully filled shift and long-term engagement. This remote-first opportunity offers significant ownership, cross-functional influence, and the chance to make a tangible difference for veterinary professionals and animal healthcare providers.

- Growth strategy and planning: Develop and execute the hospital growth strategy in partnership with business and product leadership, setting measurable targets for acquisition, activation, reactivation, expansion, customer acquisition cost, and payback.

- Budget and channel management: Own the growth marketing budget and channel mix, allocating investment across geographic markets based on hospital demand, veterinary professional availability, expected shift-fill rates, and long-term customer value.

- Multi-channel acquisition: Lead B2B lead generation and account-based marketing initiatives alongside Sales, as well as direct-to-practice-manager acquisition through paid search, paid social, SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), referrals, direct mail, sponsorships, and strategic partnerships.

- Campaign development: Design and execute hospital-focused acquisition campaigns, contribute hospital targeting and conversion strategies to broader brand campaigns, and collaborate on industry conferences, webinars, sponsorships, and community events.

- Lead targeting and sales alignment: Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, and Analytics to improve hospital targeting, lead scoring, routing, and handoff processes, ensuring the right prospects receive appropriate support through field teams or automated outreach.

- Activation and conversion optimization: Own the conversion rate optimization roadmap, experimentation backlog, and first-fill playbook, improving the customer journey from landing page visits and registration through approval, shift posting, and successful shift fulfillment.

- Experimentation and product collaboration: Work with Product and Growth Analytics to design, launch, and evaluate A/B tests and product experiments that improve sign-up conversion, onboarding, and first-shift completion.

- Funnel analysis and customer insights: Identify friction points and drop-offs throughout the hospital journey by combining quantitative funnel analysis with qualitative feedback from practice owners, managers, and customer-facing teams.

- Lifecycle and incentive strategy: Collaborate with Lifecycle Marketing to develop onboarding, activation, and reactivation journeys, and partner with Pricing to determine incentive eligibility, offer structures, and expected returns relative to hospital lifetime value.

- Messaging and creative development: Work with Brand and Product Marketing to refine hospital positioning, messaging, campaign creative, landing pages, and website experiences using customer insights and campaign performance data.

- Retention and expansion: Lead initiatives to reactivate dormant or churned hospitals and those struggling to fill shifts, while developing programs that increase repeat bookings and adoption across additional veterinary staffing roles.

- Measurement and attribution: Establish a rigorous growth measurement framework covering acquisition costs, cohort activation, shift-fill rates, customer lifetime value, payback periods, attribution, and controlled experiments, including holdout groups to measure incremental impact.

- Performance reporting: Communicate results, budget utilization, and key learnings to business and marketing leadership, reallocating investment toward effective programs and making data-informed decisions when results fall short of expectations.

- Marketplace coordination: Partner closely with the veterinary professional marketplace team to align hospital demand generation with professional supply, prioritizing markets where both sides of the marketplace can grow sustainably.

- Growth infrastructure and leadership: Build repeatable testing frameworks, operating processes, and performance playbooks that establish a scalable foundation for long-term growth while promoting continuous improvement and cross-functional accountability.

## Requirements:

- Demonstrated experience in growth marketing or performance marketing, ideally serving small and medium-sized businesses within a marketplace, vertical SaaS, staffing, healthcare, or related environment.

- Proven ability to own a growth budget and channel mix, make investment decisions, and deliver measurable business outcomes beyond clicks, leads, or registrations.

- Strong understanding of full-funnel growth, including customer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, reactivation, and expansion, with experience improving customer activation and repeat usage.

- Hands-on experience with B2B acquisition channels, including paid search, paid social, referrals, sponsorships, partnerships, and direct mail, with the ability to evaluate channel effectiveness and discontinue underperforming investments.

- Experience developing account-based marketing campaigns for high-priority accounts alongside broader demand generation initiatives is an advantage.

- Strong analytical capabilities, including experience with customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, payback periods, attribution, cohort analysis, and incrementality measurement.

- Demonstrated expertise in designing and evaluating controlled experiments, A/B tests, and holdout studies, including the ability to interpret negative results objectively and communicate findings to leadership.

- Experience diagnosing conversion barriers and identifying the underlying causes of customer drop-off, with a track record of translating insights into measurable improvements.

- Familiarity with lead scoring, lead routing, sales handoffs, and collaboration with field sales or account management teams to improve pipeline quality and conversion.

- Ability to analyze geographic performance and allocate resources according to market-level economics, particularly in two-sided marketplaces where customer demand must align with available supply.

- Strong customer understanding, with the ability to communicate clearly and credibly with small business owners, practice managers, and other decision-makers.

- Experience collaborating across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Pricing, Analytics, Brand, and Customer Success without relying on formal authority.

- Excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to write effective creative briefs and align teams around shared growth objectives.

- A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate in ambiguous environments, build programs from scratch, take ownership, and adapt quickly as priorities evolve.

- Practical familiarity with AI tools for increasing marketing productivity, alongside a thoughtful perspective on using AI agents to automate or improve manual outreach.

- A commitment to customer problem-solving, measurable impact, urgency, continuous learning, constructive collaboration, and maintaining strong relationships in a remote-first environment.

- Experience in veterinary medicine, animal healthcare, staffing, or related marketplaces is a plus.

## Benefits:

- Competitive annual salary: Compensation varies by geographic tier and is based on experience, skills, and location:

- Tier 1 — San Francisco and New York City: $140,000–$195,000 USD.

- Tier 2 — Los Angeles, Boston, Seattle, Washington, DC, San Diego, and Chicago: $125,000–$175,000 USD.

- Tier 3 — Austin, Dallas, Portland, Denver, Philadelphia, Baltimore, and Sacramento: $120,000–$165,000 USD.

- Tier 4 — Minneapolis, Miami, Atlanta, Phoenix, Orlando, Las Vegas, and Salt Lake City: $110,000–$155,000 USD.

- Tier 5 — Madison, Birmingham, San Antonio, Spokane, and other designated locations: $105,000–$145,000 USD.

- Equity participation: Opportunity to share in the organization's success through an equity program.

- Flexible paid time off: Unlimited PTO for eligible full-time US employees, encouraging a healthy work-life balance and time to recharge.

- Comprehensive healthcare: Medical coverage with the base medical plan covered at 100%, alongside optional premium plans and additional health benefits.

- Wellness support: Monthly wellness stipends to support personal health and well-being.

- Home office support: Stipends to help establish and maintain a productive remote workspace.

- Learning and development: Continuing education stipends and opportunities for accelerated professional growth.

- Retirement savings: Access to a 401(k) plan.

- Family and reproductive care leave: Paid maternity, paternity, and reproductive care leave.

- Team connection: Opportunities for domestic travel, including regional team-building events.

- Recognition and appreciation: Birthday and work anniversary gifts.

- Remote-first flexibility: Work remotely across eligible US locations. Employees based in San Francisco should expect a hybrid working arrangement.

- Meaningful mission: Help independent veterinary hospitals access reliable staffing while enabling veterinary professionals to earn more and enjoy greater flexibility in their careers.

- High-impact ownership: Build and lead a dedicated growth marketing function, influence business strategy, and directly shape the acquisition and retention engine.

We’re a fully remote company with a dynamic team that values autonomy, communication, and collaboration.

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced SEO and Content Marketing Strategist to join our team. This contract role requires a dual focus on developing and executing advanced SEO strategies while supporting content marketing initiatives for B2B and enterprise clients. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of SEO best practices, be highly organized, self-directed, and capable of managing complex SEO projects from start to finish.

Key Responsibilities:

- Content Strategy & Development:

- Work closely with the content team to align SEO objectives with content strategy, ensuring that content is optimized for both search engines and user experience.

- Develop and execute content strategies for websites, landing pages, and other digital assets, focusing on SEO-driven content that aligns with client goals.

- Utilize Voice of Customer (VoC) insights and keyword research to inform content creation, ensuring that messaging resonates with target personas.

- Conduct content audits to identify gaps and opportunities, recommending improvements to boost organic search visibility.

- Optimize existing content for SEO, ensuring that all digital assets adhere to the latest SEO guidelines and best practices.

- SEO Strategy & Execution:

- Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive SEO strategies tailored to the specific needs of B2B clients, with an emphasis on increasing organic traffic and improving search engine rankings.

- Perform in-depth keyword research, focusing on high-intent keywords that drive qualified traffic and conversions.

- Conduct technical SEO audits, identifying and resolving issues related to site architecture, crawlability, and indexing.

- Optimize on-page elements, including meta tags, headers, content, and internal linking structures, to enhance SEO performance.

- Collaborate with the development team to ensure that SEO best practices are followed during website updates and redesigns.

- Drive off-page SEO strategies, including link building, outreach, and digital PR, to enhance domain authority and backlink profiles.

- Analyze competitors' SEO strategies to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.

- Client Management & Reporting:

- Lead client calls, presenting SEO performance reports, discussing strategic initiatives, and managing expectations effectively.

- Prepare and deliver detailed SEO reports, including analysis of traffic, rankings, conversions, and other key metrics.

- Provide clients with actionable insights and recommendations based on data-driven analysis, helping them achieve their digital marketing objectives.

- Continuous Improvement & Collaboration:

- Stay updated on the latest SEO trends, algorithm updates, and industry developments, continuously refining strategies to maintain and improve performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including web developers, designers, and content creators, to deliver cohesive and impactful digital marketing campaigns.

- Contribute to internal knowledge sharing and team development by staying abreast of emerging SEO tools and techniques.

Requirements

- 4+ years of experience in SEO, with a strong focus on B2B campaigns.

- Proven experience in content strategy development, particularly for websites, landing pages, and digital marketing assets.

- Deep understanding of SEO principles, including keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and link building.

- Proficiency with SEO tools such as Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, and other related platforms.

- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to lead client calls and manage expectations effectively.

- Experience in the B2B, SaaS, or tech industry.

- Strong project management skills, with the ability to work autonomously in a remote environment, managing multiple projects and deadlines.

- Experience with content management systems and project management software (e.g., Asana).

Major Pluses:

- Previous experience at a digital marketing agency.

- Proven track record with case studies or a personal portfolio of successful SEO and content strategy work.

- Experience with WordPress development, marketing automation, and CRMs.

- Knowledge of cross-domain strategies (CRO, UI/UX, Paid Media, etc.).

- Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and time-tracking software.

- Familiarity with GIF-based communication (we love a good GIF!).

Benefits

Location: Remote

Position: Contract

Salary: $40 - 50/ hour

record.Gecko Job Description:
Logical Media Group strives to create exceptional digital experiences for people to connect, transact, and explore. At the core of that lies with our partnership with our clients and ensuring their needs and goals are at the forefront of all our efforts. The focus of the B2B HubSpot Growth Marketing Manager will be to serve as an integral role in identifying and creating high value and high impact strategies for our clients across delivery and account management teams; this will involve supporting CRM standards and program strategies through omni-channel collaboration, monitoring the success of those initiatives, and continually enhancing and optimizing that service value for our clients. This role will primarily focus on the ideation and execution of B2B marketing and customer journey initiatives for our clients, contributing to the growth of this channel at Logical. 

Requirements

Primary Responsibilities Include: 

Working across Account Teams

- Collaborate with cross-functional account teams to ensure seamless execution of high impact initiatives and consumer journeys from kickoff to launch, with special attention to how client’s sales and marketing teams need to collaborate 

- Focus on the core business KPIs for clients, develop and implement cross-channel programs that align to key moments of need within the customer’s journey based on insights from analytics and behavioral science

- Partner with client stakeholders to operationalize program-based strategies and develop cross-channel programs and initiatives that increase key performance indicators

- Lead strategic meetings (both internally and externally) to align on client goals and ensure that programs are operating in service of unique customer journey needs

- Work across accounts to oversee the creation of emails, forms, landing pages, reports, and other related infrastructure to optimize performance of our marketing efforts

- Build custom multi channel reports and implement reporting processes that capture key insights, and define account success, while also identifying opportunities for continued improvements in efficiency, effectiveness, and impact of the complex, consumer-centric marketing strategies

- Maintain data hygiene and data/list integrity standards, including managing data and integrations between marketing and sales platforms (Hubspot, Salesforce, Marketo, Pardot, etc), and creating standards if they do not exist

- Participate in campaign planning to develop and maintain all project aspects, including timelines/schedules, budget, progress/status reports, and messaging/copy if needed.

- Identify customer segments for targeted marketing programs and plan consumer loyalty and engagement programs to deliver ROI-positive results

- Identify and mitigate risk, specifically how CRM changes may impact reporting and other processes; support account manager in managing client expectations, and ensuring client-delivery alignment between requirements and downstream deliverables.

Working with the Sales Team 

- Craft service narratives to communicate what we are building in service of our client’s mission, the outcomes we deliver to our customers, and the continued value Logical Media Group can provide to increase client success

- Assist Account Management and Director of Growth with creating clear business cases for new engagement opportunities, and get buy-in from key clients and stakeholders

- Articulate business and functional requirements of CRM, engaging in strategic storytelling to align and inspire a wide range of internal and external stakeholders

Requirements: 

- CRM platform proficiency, Hubspot preferred but not required. This includes but is not limited to competency in implementing, optimizing and speaking to workflows created as a part of a customer experience journey, list hygiene, and lead scoring. 

- An understanding of the nuances and challenges of tailoring performance marketing channels to unique customer journeys and/or Account Based Marketing needs

- Experience in identifying new marketing channels and target audiences, and devising marketing strategies that engage, inform and motivate innovation and ongoing optimization of performance for clients

- Comfortability with collaboration and presentation, both internally and client facing 

- Passion for creative problem-solving, working independently and sometimes without clear instruction. This position will be creating and optimizing processes in live time. 

- 2+ years of B2B strategy experience in-house or agency preferred 

Benefits

Logical Media Group Benefits

- Medical, Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, and Life insurance

- 401(k) plus match, to help plan for your future

- Paid time off (starting at 15 days), plus paid holidays, paid sick days, and paid personal days.

- Flexible Fridays

- Option to work completely remote

- Access to senior management and mentoring opportunities

- Optional COVID safe company gatherings

Logical is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. Each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company.

AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
 
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. 
 
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. 
 
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD. 

As a Field Marketing Manager, you will lead the development and execution of integrated marketing plans that generate awareness and drive pipeline growth across AHEAD’s Central Region. This highly collaborative role partners closely with marketing, sales, and external agencies to align strategy, ensure flawless execution, and report on performance and outcomes. 
Serving as the primary bridge between the Central Region and the broader marketing organization, you will ensure tight coordination across teams, consistency in messaging and branding, and effective activation of campaigns, partner initiatives, and regional deliverables. You’ll also champion regional engagement in national campaigns—helping to localize content, refine audience targeting, and align messaging to meet regional business needs. 
The ideal candidate brings a strong track record in field marketing and a hands-on approach to execution. This position reports directly to the Director of Field Marketing. It offers a unique opportunity to make a direct and measurable impact on regional business growth. 

- 

Develop and execute integrated field and regional marketing strategies tailored to the Central Region, driving brand awareness, pipeline growth, and customer engagement across target accounts and industries. 

- 

Design and activate executive engagement programs, including CxO-level experiences and high-touch events that deepen relationships with strategic customers and prospects. 

- 

Lead the planning, execution, and optimization of regional demand generation and pipeline acceleration initiatives, aligned with both corporate and field priorities. 

- 

Partner closely with sales, product marketing, demand generation, and GTM teams to ensure cross-functional alignment on messaging, campaign strategy, and audience targeting. 

- 

Build and sustain strong relationships with GTM and technology partners to support brand consistency and deliver impactful co-marketing and partner programs across the region. 

- 

Drive and execute account-based marketing (ABM) strategies focused on high-value accounts, tailoring campaigns and events to accelerate sales cycles and increase engagement. 

- 

Manage and analyze campaign performance, KPIs, and ROI, using data and analytics to continually optimize programs and report impact to sales and marketing leadership. 

- 

Ensure clear and consistent communication with the regional sales team, educating on upcoming programs, assets, and global-to-local campaign activation opportunities. 

- 

Collaborate with national and global teams to scale successful programs across markets and ensure regional participation in corporate campaigns. 

- 

Lead the planning and flawless execution of high-touch regional events, customer roundtables, and partner activations—while also supporting key national initiatives led by the Experience Marketing team. 

- 

Oversee and manage the Central Region marketing budget, ensuring high-impact use of resources that deliver measurable business results. 

- 

Serve as a brand ambassador at industry conferences, executive forums, and customer engagements, strengthening AHEAD’s presence and visibility in the Central Region. 

The ideal candidate has a strong track record of executing field marketing strategies that drive revenue through compelling content, integrated programs, and measurable impact. They bring a deep understanding of marketing best practices across digital channels, a data-driven mindset, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives with precision and creativity. 

- Minimum Required – 5+ Years of experience in similar role

- 

Proven experience developing and executing integrated, ROI-focused marketing and pipeline generation programs 

- 

Strong knowledge of account-based marketing (ABM) strategies and execution 

- 

Demonstrated expertise in both project management and event execution 

- 

Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM platforms, ideally including Marketo, Salesforce, and Demandbase 

- 

Highly analytical, with a passion for using data to drive decisions and optimize performance 

- 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills 

- 

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage time effectively across competing priorities 

- Willingness to travel up to 40% as needed for business needs.

 The compensation range indicated in this posting reflects the On-Target Earnings (“OTE”) for this role, which includes a base salary and any applicable target bonus amount. This OTE range may vary based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and geographic location.

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
 
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.
 
USA Employment Benefits include: 
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 
- 401(k) 
- Paid company holidays 
- Paid time off 
- Paid parental and caregiver leave 
- Plus more! See benefits https://www.aheadbenefits.com/ for additional details.

record.Gecko Job Description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

We create technology to help businesses grow and succeed. Our Marketing Operations team is looking for a technically sharp, operationally minded Manager to own the infrastructure behind our paid media program — from pixel to pipeline, feed to finance. This role is the engine behind our buying team, ensuring every campaign we run is accurately tracked and our media buyers can focus on performance rather than data.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

  • Own the full signal path for Paid: serve as the single technical owner across Tracking/Pixels, Program/Campaign, Audience/Conversions API, and Control Tower - partnering with Paid on requirements once and carrying them across every team, rather than Paid routing to individuals separately
  • Tag & pixel infrastructure: own event tracking, conversion signals, and audience data flows across ad platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, Bing, ChatGPT, etc.) via offline conversion tracking and server-side tagging
  • Marketing automation: manage and optimize Marketo paid program setup, scoring, audience segmentation, and integration with ad platforms
  • Data operations: manage CRM audience syncs and data pipelines between source systems and ad platforms using ETL systems
  • UTM & tracking governance: define and enforce naming conventions, UTM taxonomy, QA checklists, and bulk build processes to ensure every campaign launched is trackable and consistent
  • Platform integrations & API management: manage connections between marketing tech systems (Marketo, Salesforce, ad platforms) and troubleshoot data discrepancies across the stack
  • Launch playbooks & QA framework: build and maintain the launch playbook for new vendors, channels, and tests; own time-to-launch as a core metric and continuously shrink it
  • Control Tower & monitoring: own Paid's coverage within our Control Tower alerting suite, publish and follow a QA cadence (daily monitors, monthly tests, quarterly audits), and drive down time-to-detect on data issues
  • Reporting & analytics infrastructure: maintain and QA the data pipelines that feed performance dashboards, ensuring campaign, lead, and conversion data is accurate and available for stakeholder reporting
  • Audience operations: build, maintain, and refresh CRM-based audience lists for suppression, retargeting, and lookalike seeding across ad platforms

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years in marketing operations, ad tech, or marketing analytics
  • Experience managing infrastructure for paid spend at $10M+ a year across 3+ ad platforms
  • Hands-on experience with offline conversion tracking (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or equivalent), including sending CRM-stage conversions back to platforms
  • Experience with a marketing automation platform (Marketo, HubSpot, or similar)
  • Experience with CRM systems and lead routing logic (Salesforce or equivalent)
  • Experience managing data pipelines and integrations via Hightouch or similar ETL tools
  • Strong UTM governance and tracking QA across multi-channel paid campaigns
  • Track record operating as an embedded technical partner to a Paid/growth team — driving requirements proactively rather than waiting on tickets
  • Ability to troubleshoot data discrepancies and communicate findings to cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong attention to detail and a bias toward process and documentation
  • A sense of humor

Special Sauce* (nice to haves)

  • Owned a cost efficiency metric as part of your function
  • Part of the team or led the move to value-based bidding with measurable CAC or pipeline impact
  • Experience working within a B2B SaaS environment
  • Proficiency with Marketo, including program setup, lead scoring, and ad platform integrations
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM, including lead routing, campaign attribution, and data hygiene
  • Experience with a CDP or data warehouse tool (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery)
  • Familiarity with SQL for data QA and ad-hoc reporting
  • Experience with TikTok or other emerging ad platform integrations beyond Meta and Google
  • Prior experience in an embedded ops role supporting a paid media team

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.


Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Zone A
$124,000—$198,000 USD

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. About the Job
Mars Men is one of the fastest growing DTC brands in the US, achieving $100M run rate in less then 18 months. Recently backed by L Catterton, Mars Men is positioned to become the leading men’s health brand in the supplement space. We operate across DTC, retail, and emerging channels, and are entering our next phase of growth as we continue scaling the business.

We’re looking for an exceptional Paid Search & YouTube Manager to help scale Mars Men’s next stage of growth. You’ll own the strategy, execution, and day-to-day performance of our Google Ads and YouTube Ads channels, driving efficient customer acquisition while growing revenue and acquisition volume.
You’ll work closely with our Growth, Creative, and Analytics teams to translate business goals into campaign strategy, build a structured testing roadmap, and continuously improve performance. This is a role for a highly analytical, hands-on performance marketer who takes ownership of channel results, knows how to turn data into action, and thrives in a fast-moving environment where their work has a direct impact on the business.

- Own and scale the day-to-day performance of our Google Ads and YouTube Ads channels, deploying budgets effectively to hit CPA, acquisition volume, and revenue targets while identifying opportunities to scale efficiently.

- Develop and execute campaign strategies aligned with business goals across keyword targeting, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, campaign structure, and budget allocation.

- Build and lead a structured testing roadmap across ad copy, creative, landing pages, audiences, and bidding strategies, using performance insights to continuously improve results.

- Analyze and optimize full-funnel performance to identify trends, diagnose account inefficiencies, investigate fluctuations in results, and uncover opportunities to improve conversion rates and drive profitable growth.

- Strengthen measurement and attribution by optimizing conversion tracking, improving signal quality, and partnering with Analytics to ensure accurate reporting and effective performance-based bidding.

- Collaborate and stay ahead by working closely with Growth and Creative on campaign performance and funnel efficiency while keeping up with changes in search, paid media, and AI-driven advertising.

- 3–5+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience, ideally at a fast-growing DTC, eCommerce, subscription, or consumer brand, with a track record of improving performance and scaling acquisition.

- Deep expertise in paid search and Google Ads, with the ability to independently build, manage, troubleshoot, and optimize campaigns and translate business objectives into effective channel strategy. Experience with YouTube Ads is strongly preferred.

- Proven ability to own performance against CPA and ROAS targets, balancing acquisition volume, revenue growth, and efficiency while making sound decisions about when and where to scale spend.

- Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to problem-solving, with advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and experience using GA4, Northbeam, or similar analytics and attribution tools.

- A deep understanding of conversion tracking and measurement, including attribution, conversion signals, and performance-based bidding, with the ability to identify data quality issues and turn insights into actionable improvements.

- A strong bias toward ownership and action, with the ability to operate independently, prioritize effectively, communicate clearly, and move work forward in a fast-paced startup environment.

 Life at Mars Men
Competitive Compensation - We offer a strong salary and benefits package, tailored to attract top talent
Remote Work Environment - Our team is remote, offering full flexibility to work from home
Autonomy & Ownership - You’ll have the freedom to run your own systems and make real impact
Time Off - 15 PTO days per year (prorated), 9 company holidays, plus your birthday off
Parental Leave - Generous paid parental leave for growing families
Health Benefits - 100% premium coverage for health, dental, and vision plans, with 25% coverage for dependents
401(k) - Company-sponsored plan with a 2% match through Guideline (elective participation)
$200 Annual Superpower Membership
Growth & Development - We invest in your professional development with ongoing learning opportunities
